3112335.h: Jokic totaled 18 points (6-14 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 5-5 FT), 11 rebounds, five assists, one steal and five turnovers across 33 minutes in Tuesday's 120-101 loss to the Mavs.

3112335.h: Jokic recorded 37 points (14-22 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 8-10 FT), 18 rebounds, 11 assists, one steal and a block in 42 minutes during Sunday's 151-145 overtime win over the Bulls.

The star big man has now posted four triple-doubles this season.

3112335.h: Jokic chipped in 26 points (10-15 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds and 11 assists over 38 minutes during Friday's 133-124 victory over the Rockets.
3112335.s: Jokic was his usual efficient self, leading Denver in scoring and assists. He capped the night by setting up an Aaron Gordon alley-oop in the final seconds. 3112335.h: Jokic produced 28 points (12-21 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 15 rebounds, seven assists, one steal and one block in 38 minutes during Monday's 117-105 loss to Phoenix.
3112335.s: Jokic tied with Jamal Murray for the team lead in scoring, and the big man led Denver in rebounds on the way to a double-double. 3112335.h: Jokic recorded 26 points (9-14 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 7-7 FT), eight rebounds, 10 assists and three steals across 37 minutes in Saturday's 116-108 win over the Pelicans.

3134907.h: Kuzma registered 26 points (9-16 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 6-10 FT), five rebounds, one assist, one block and two steals over 30 minutes during Wednesday's 137-130 loss to Miami.
3134907.s: Kuzma led Milwaukee in scoring while delivering an efficient offensive performance, though his contributions outside the scoring column remained modest. The veteran forward continues to provide the Bucks with a reliable scoring option, but his fantasy value depends heavily on his offensive production. His ability to contribute across multiple defensive categories offers some additional upside in category leagues.

3134907.h: Kuzma registered 27 points (10-17 FG, 6-13 3Pt, 1-2 FT), four rebounds, one steal and two blocks across 31 minutes in Sunday's 117-97 loss to the Celtics.
3134907.s: Kuzma delivered an impressive scoring performance, connecting on six three-pointers while adding three combined steals-plus-blocks. This 27-point output was not only Kuzma's best scoring output of the season, but it also represented the first time he's scored at least 20 points in the current campaign. Kuzma is averaging just 12.4 points per game over his last five appearances, so this was likely a one-game outlier…

3134907.h: Kuzma ended with two points (1-6 FG, 0-4 3Pt), two rebounds, three assists and one steal over 22 minutes during Monday's 112-100 loss to the Timberwolves.
3134907.s: Kuzma endured another frustrating offensive outing, missing all four of his three-point attempts while finishing with a team-worst minus-22 rating. He attempted just six shots despite starting, while Milwaukee received more productive performances from Jaime Jaquez and its reserves. Kuzma's limited playing time and inconsistent scoring make him difficult to trust in standard fantasy formats.

3134907.h: Kuzma posted 14 points (6-11 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds and three assists across 35 minutes in Saturday's 127-116 loss to the 76ers.
3134907.s: Kuzma delivered his strongest contribution on the glass, collecting 12 rebounds while playing a team-high 35 minutes. However, his scoring remained modest, and he failed to register a steal or block. His substantial workload offers some fantasy stability, but with Milwaukee featuring several offensive options, Kuzma may need consistent rebounding to compensate for the ups and downs in his scoring production. He's…

3134907.h: Kuzma totaled five points (2-9 FG, 1-4 3Pt), six rebounds, three assists and three steals in 27 minutes during Wednesday's 128-116 loss to Washington.
3134907.s: Kuzma endured a difficult shooting night against his former team, converting just two of nine attempts while committing three turnovers. His three steals helped offset the offensive struggles, but he was outscored by several Milwaukee reserves, including Kasparas Jakucionis and Brayden Burries. Kuzma remains part of the Bucks' starting lineup, though his scoring consistency and offensive role will be worth…

3134908.h: Poeltl recorded 15 points (5-10 FG, 5-6 FT), 10 rebounds, three assists, one block and one steal in 28 minutes before fouling out of Monday's 116-111 loss to the Bucks.
3134908.s: Poeltl followed up Friday's 10-point, nine-rebound effort against Detroit with a double-double, though foul trouble prevented him from reaching the 30-minute mark. The veteran center's efficiency from the charity stripe was particularly encouraging given his historical struggles in that department. Poeltl's playing time will be worth monitoring with Collin Murray-Boyles also gunning for minutes at center, but his…

3134908.h: Poeltl chipped in 10 points (5-7 FG), nine rebounds, three assists and two blocks across 32 minutes during Friday's 105-102 victory over Detroit.
3134908.s: Poeltl narrowly missed a double-double but delivered one of Toronto's most important plays, tipping in a missed Scottie Barnes layup with 27 seconds remaining to break a 99-99 tie. His 32-minute workload was encouraging, as this was the first time he reached the 30-minute mark since Nov. 11. Although his scoring ceiling is limited, Poeltl's ability to provide rebounds, blocks and strong field-goal percentage makes…

3134908.h: Poeltl will start Wednesday's game against the Wizards.
3134908.s: Poeltl came off the bench for the previous two games, but he will return to a starting role due to RJ Barrett (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin) being out. Over his last four starts, Poeltl holds averages of 13.0 points, 8.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists, 1.5 blocks and 1.3 steals in 29.8 minutes per contest.

3134908.h: Poeltl closed Tuesday's 111-102 loss to the Knicks with three points (1-3 FG, 1-2 FT), six rebounds, one assist and one steal over 18 minutes.
3134908.s: Poeltl continues to see his role diminish, logging fewer than 19 minutes in consecutive games after averaging nearly 30 minutes over his previous three appearances. The veteran center has moved to a reserve role behind Collin Murray-Boyles, limiting his opportunities to contribute consistently. Poeltl's reduced playing time significantly lowers his fantasy ceiling despite his rebounding ability.

3134908.h: Poeltl isn't starting Sunday's game against the Knicks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
3134908.s: Poeltl will come off the bench for the second time this season, as the Raptors are electing to roll with Collin Murray-Boyles at center. Poeltl finished with eight points, five rebounds and one assist across 19 minutes in his previous appearance as a reserve Nov. 4 against Denver.

3134908.h: Poeltl chipped in 18 points (9-12 FG), seven rebounds, two assists, four blocks and one steal across 31 minutes during Monday's 118-102 loss to the Grizzlies.
3134908.s: Poeltl played at least 30 minutes for the second straight game, blocking a season-high four shots. The situation in Toronto continues to be a confusing one, with Poeltl looking like a spent force to begin the season. He now looks like the Poeltl of old, putting up solid contributions on both ends of the floor. While injuries have certainly factored into the minutes available, Poeltl should be added in most leagues…

3134908.h: Poeltl contributed 19 points (9-14 FG, 1-1 FT), 11 rebounds, two assists, one block and three steals in 31 minutes during Friday's 121-107 victory over the Bucks.
3134908.s: The veteran center has been dealing with shoulder trouble to begin the season, but with Scottie Barnes (groin) unavailable Friday, Poeltl returned to the starting five and delivered his second double-double of the season, as well as a season high in minutes. Over his six starts so far in 2026-27, Poeltl is averaging 7.0 points, 6.7 boards, 1.2 assists and 1.0 steals in just 22.0 minutes, but Friday's performance was…

3134908.h: Poeltl (shoulder) is available to play in Friday's game versus Milwaukee.
3134908.s: Poeltl has been battling left shoulder bursitis. Despite recently missing two games because of the issue, it won't keep him off the floor against the Bucks. Poeltl came off the bench in Wednesday's 128-109 loss to the Nuggets, though with the Raptors shorthanded Friday, he could find his way back into the starting lineup.

3134908.h: Poeltl (shoulder) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Milwaukee.
3134908.s: Poeltl is still a little banged up for Toronto, but he intends to push through it. On Wednesday against Denver, he played 19 minutes off the bench with eight points, five rebounds and one assist.

3134908.h: Poeltl (shoulder) is available for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
3134908.s: Poeltl missed the Raptors' last two games due to left shoulder bursitis, though he'll shed his questionable tag and suit up for Wednesday's meeting. With the big man back in the mix, fewer minutes will be available for Collin Murray-Boyles and Trayce Jackson-Davis.

3134916.s: McLaughlin will shake off the questionable tag in order to suit up versus Sacramento. He'll be in line for a much larger role than usual with De'Aaron Fox (shin) and Dylan Harper (hip) both ruled out.

With De'Aaron Fox (shin) also questionable and Dylan Harper (hip) already sidelined, McLaughlin would be in line to receive extra minutes if he manages to suit up. 3134916.h: McLaughlin produced zero points (0-1 FG), five assists, three steals and one rebound over 11 minutes during Thursday's 124-112 win over the Clippers.
3134916.s: McLaughlin was held scoreless but still racked up season highs in assists and steals. He has averaged 4.2 points, 2.0 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.2 steals across 11.5 minutes per game over his last six appearances, and the 30-year-old could continue to see meaningful playing time in Dylan Harper's (hip) absence.

3134916.h: McLaughlin provided 10 points (4-5 FG, 2-3 3Pt), two assists, one rebound and one steal in 19 minutes during Sunday's 110-102 win over the Jazz.
3134916.s: The veteran guard delivered an efficient performance and provided a spark off the bench in De'Aaron Fox's (hip) absence. McLaughlin logged a season high in minutes en route to a season-best scoring total. He's logged double-digit minutes in four of his last five appearances, averaging 5.0 points, 2.2 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.8 steals in 11.6 minutes per contest during that span.

3134916.h: McLaughlin logged zero points (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt), two assists and one steal in seven minutes during Tuesday's 130-103 win over Sacramento.
3134916.s: McLaughlin appeared for just the second time this season, with all of his minutes thus far coming during garbage time. McLaughlin has barely been in the rotation throughout his career, a trend that seems likely to continue moving forward. For fantasy leagues, he holds no value.

3134916.s: The Spurs are resting their usual starters for Monday's exhibition, so it'll be McLaughlin starting alongside Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson, Harrison Barnes and Luke Kornet. McLaughlin and Ja'Kobi Gillespie figure to handle the point-guard duties for San Antonio on Monday.

3135045.h: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Chicago.
3135045.s: Allen will miss a fourth consecutive contest due to a concussion. With the veteran swingman sidelined, Sion James (thigh), Grant Williams and Royce O'Neale are candidates for increased playing time. Allen's next chance to play will come Saturday against Brooklyn.

3135045.h: Allen (concussion) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus Chicago.
3135045.s: Allen has missed the last three games. While it appears he's working toward returning, he's not a lock to get back on the floor Wednesday against the Bulls. If Allen remains on the shelf, Sion James (thigh) and Christian Anderson may continue to see more minutes.

3135045.h: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
3135045.s: Allen is set to miss a third consecutive contest due to a concussion. Sion James will continue to start while Royce O'Neale should get more minutes off the bench.

3135045.h: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Atlanta.
3135045.s: Allen is currently dealing with concussion-like symptoms and is in line for a second straight absence. Sion James and Royce O'Neale should continue to see an uptick in playing time until Allen is cleared to return.

3135045.h: Allen (concussion-like symptoms) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.
3135045.s: With Allen on the shelf, Royce O'Neale and Christian Anderson should see a boost in minutes off the Hornets' bench. Allen's next chance to suit up will come Friday versus the Hawks.

3135045.h: Allen is not listed in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3135045.s: Allen will shift back to the bench after starting the previous three contests with Brandon Miller (groin) returning from a two-game absence. Allen should remain a vital part of the Hornets' rotation, as he's averaging 15.2 points, 2.9 rebounds, 3.3 assists, 0.8 steals and 3.5 three-pointers in 27.3 minutes across 12 outings this season.

3135045.h: Allen logged 14 points (5-11 FG, 4-8 3Pt), four rebounds, six assists and one steal over 34 minutes during Thursday's 101-96 loss to Phoenix.
3135045.s: Few players have benefited more from Charlotte's backcourt injuries than Allen, whose expanded responsibilities have helped him average 15.2 points and 3.5 three-pointers per game. His 46.9 percent shooting from deep has been a major asset, and the additional playmaking opportunities are a welcome bonus. The bigger question is whether he'll maintain this level of involvement once the Hornets return to full strength,…

3135045.h: Allen finished with 27 points (8-14 FG, 6-12 3Pt, 5-6 FT), four rebounds, six assists and two steals across 34 minutes during Monday's 124-112 win over Cleveland.
3135045.s: Allen erupted for a game-high 27 points after going scoreless in Friday's 119-80 loss to the Celtics. Monday's outing marked the second straight start for the former Sun, and he's now eclipsed the 20-point threshold in three of his last five games. Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is sidelined for at least another four weeks, so Allen is likely to continue seeing a heavy workload, with Brandon Miller (groin) also out.

3135045.h: Allen will start in Friday's game against the Celtics
3135045.s: With Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (thigh) ruled out, Allen will make his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. In 27 regular-season starts with the Suns in 2025-26, the 31-year-old averaged 17.6 points, 3.0 rebounds, 4.1 assists and 1.4 steals over 31.0 minutes per contest.

3135045.h: Allen ended Wednesday's 114-104 loss to the Nets with 22 points (6-11 FG, 5-7 3Pt, 5-5 FT), two rebounds, four assists, one block and one steal in 27 minutes.
3135045.s: Allen scored at least 22 points for the second time in the past three games, providing Charlotte with a nice scoring punch off the bench. Although his arrow is likely headed in the wrong direction, another leg injury to Kon Knueppel could ensure Allen remains a viable asset in most fantasy formats, at least for the time being. If he was dropped in your league, adding him might be the way to go.

3135046.h: Jones totaled two points (1-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and three assists across 10 minutes during Saturday's 116-108 win over the Pelicans.
3135046.s: Jones had another underwhelming offensive performance Saturday and is now averaging just 2.5 points in 11 regular-season appearances during the 2026-27 campaign. He has been a little more active as a distributor of late, however, amassing 19 assists in his last five games.

3135046.h: Jones accumulated six points (3-4 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one rebound and eight assists over 18 minutes during Wednesday's 128-109 win over the Raptors.
3135046.s: After handing out four dimes across his previous six games, Jones doubled his entire prior season output with eight assists in his seventh appearance of the year Wednesday. As long as Jamal Murray is healthy, Jones' fantasy upside will likely remain limited.

3135046.h: Jones ended Thursday's 96-84 loss to the Thunder with two points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt) and one steal in 10 minutes.
3135046.s: Jones played a limited role off Denver's bench, failing to record an assist while seeing just 10 minutes of action. With Jamal Murray handling the bulk of the point guard duties, Jones could struggle to provide consistent fantasy value unless his playing time increases.

3135046.h: Jones will start in Sunday's preseason opener against the Jazz.
3135046.s: Jones will get the spot start with Jamal Murray (personal) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Christian Braun, Cameron Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic. Jones can rack up the dimes and defensive stats when given the minutes, so he'll be someone to consider as a streamer whenever he gets the opportunity to fill in as a starter this season.

3136193.h: Booker racked up 25 points (6-18 FG, 2-9 3Pt, 11-12 FT), five assists and one steal in 36 minutes during Wednesday's 116-104 loss to Houston.
3136193.s: Booker has shot just 37.3 percent from the field over his last three appearances, but his substantial offensive workload keeps his fantasy value secure. His ability to draw fouls helps offset inefficient shooting, particularly in points leagues.

3136193.s: Booker provided a strong scoring boost and dished out eight assists for the third time through 12 November appearances. He also made an impact on the opposite end of the court, where he accounted for three of his team's 13 steals. Booker has scored 20-plus points in four consecutive matchups.

3136193.h: Booker produced 23 points (9-22 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 4-6 FT), two rebounds and three assists across 38 minutes during Friday's 111-101 victory over the Jazz.
3136193.s: Booker led all scorers despite an off shooting night, extending a run of strong scoring games during Phoenix's perfect three-game road trip. The veteran star is averaging 24.8 points and remains the engine of a Suns team that has climbed to 8-7.

3136193.h: Booker totaled 29 points (10-18 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 7-7 FT), two rebounds, six assists and one steal in 33 minutes during Wednesday's 128-107 win over Sacramento.
3136193.s: Booker matched Dillon Brooks for Phoenix's scoring lead and continued to operate as the team's primary offensive weapon. Booker's ability to combine efficient scoring with substantial playmaking responsibilities remains central to his fantasy value, and even with Jalen Green and Dillon Brooks also handling sizable offensive roles lately, Booker hasn't lost his prominent role. The star guard has reached the 20-point…

3136193.s: Booker led Phoenix in scoring, making his biggest impact at the charity stripe while struggling with his efficiency from the field. Through 13 appearances this year, Booker is averaging 24.5 points, 5.4 assists, 2.8 rebounds and 1.2 steals while shooting 47.3 percent from the field and 34.2 percent…

3136193.s: Booker struggled with efficiency from the field but got to the charity stripe often and finished as the Suns' third-leading scorer. The star guard also paced the club in assists, dishing out seven dimes for a second straight game. Over eight appearances this month, he's averaged 26.1 points, 5.1 assists, 2.1 rebounds and 1.4 steals in 32.9 minutes per tilt.

3136193.h: Booker compiled 30 points (12-20 FG, 4-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound, seven assists, three steals and one block across 35 minutes during Thursday's 101-96 victory over the Suns.
3136193.s: Booker erupted for a game-high 30 points to help Phoenix win the fourth out of the last five games. He's now eclipsed the 30-point threshold in two of his previous three outings and four of his last six overall. Booker led all players in steals and tied teammate Oso Ighodaro with a game-best seven dimes, proving the former can do much more than just score.

3136193.h: Booker registered 17 points (6-14 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 3-4 FT), three rebounds and five assists across 29 minutes in Tuesday's 133-110 win over the Clippers.
3136193.s: Booker's 17 points were a game high, and he finished with a game-best plus-20 differential in the blowout win. The Suns have now won three of their past four games, and they'll look to earn their second straight victory Thursday against the Hornets.

3136193.h: Booker tallied 32 points (10-17 FG, 3-5 3Pt, 9-10 FT), two rebounds, four assists, one steal and one block in 29 minutes during Monday's 122-96 loss to San Antonio.
3136193.s: Booker looked more comfortable from beyond the arc in this one after hitting at a clip of 32.0 percent in his previous three appearances entering Monday. He led the Suns in the scoring department and recorded at least one steal and one block for just the second time through nine games this season. Booker continues to offer up strong production as a scorer and has totaled 30 or more points in three of his last four…

3136193.h: Booker delivered 24 points (10-24 FG, 2-9 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, three assists and three steals across 39 minutes in Saturday's 102-99 win over the Rockets.
3136193.s: Booker scored seven consecutive points late in the fourth quarter to break a 95-95 tie and propel Phoenix to its second straight victory. His three steals boosted his fantasy production despite a relatively quiet playmaking performance. Booker's substantial offensive workload remains encouraging even if the efficiency isn't always there, and he extended his streak of games with at least 20 points to five games…

3136195.h: Towns recorded 12 points (4-8 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 3-4 FT), 10 rebounds, seven assists, three blocks and one steal across 33 minutes during Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.
3136195.s: Towns had a quieter scoring night after his 30-point effort against Indiana on Monday. He made up for it as a passer and rim protector, tying his season high in blocks while posting another double-double. The big man is averaging 13.9 rebounds, among the best marks of his career.

3136195.h: Towns (knee) is available for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers, Steve Popper of Newsday reports.
3136195.s: As expected, Towns will suit up versus Cleveland after he was upgraded to probable earlier Wednesday. Karl-Anthony Towns (illness) is available for Sunday's game against the Pacers.

3136195.h: Towns tallied 22 points (9-20 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds, four assists and three blocks across 33 minutes in Thursday's 102-99 win over the Timberwolves.

3136196.h: Lyles closed with nine points (3-6 FG, 3-6 3Pt), 10 rebounds and one assist over 23 minutes during Wednesday's 113-106 win over Oklahoma City.
3136196.s: Lyles gave Minnesota solid frontcourt depth off the bench, crashing the defensive glass and stretching the floor. It was one of his best rebounding nights of the season.  He remains a reliable option behind Rudy Gobert.

3136196.h: Lyles finished Thursday's 102-99 loss to the Knicks with eight points (3-5 FG, 2-4 3Pt), five rebounds and one assist in 16 minutes.
3136196.s: Lyles has connected on multiple three-pointers in three straight games, but his minutes dropped sharply after Tuesday's 31-minute outing. His floor-spacing role provides occasional streaming value, though inconsistent playing time limits his fantasy ceiling.

3136196.h: Lyles recorded nine points (3-5 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three rebounds and one assist over 19 minutes during Monday's 106-98 victory over the Trail Blazers.
3136196.s: Lyles offered a spark off the bench in the front end of this back-to-back set against Portland, and he continues to play a meaningful role for the Timberwolves. The veteran forward has logged at least 19 minutes in six of his seven outings this month, during which he's averaged 6.7 points, 4.1 rebounds and 1.0 assists across 20.6 minutes per showing.

3136196.h: Lyles ended with five points (2-7 FG, 0-4 3Pt, 1-2 FT), 13 rebounds, two assists, one block and three steals in 29 minutes off the bench during Friday's 115-109 win over New Orleans.
3136196.s: Lyles left the scoring to others, as he instead led all players in rebounding on the night while making an impact on defense. It was the first time this season the veteran big has pulled down double-digit boards or even played more than 22 minutes, but if second-year center Joan Beringer (nose) misses more time, there will be more court time available on the second unit for Lyles.

3136196.h: Lyles had 12 points (4-9 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 2-2 FT) and four rebounds over 21 minutes during Monday's 112-100 victory over the Bucks.
3136196.s: Lyles provided a scoring spark for Minnesota's second unit, finishing as the team's leading bench scorer while connecting on two three-pointers. However, he failed to register an assist, steal or block, limiting his overall fantasy production. His reserve role and reliance on perimeter shooting make him a relatively low-upside option outside deeper leagues.

3136196.h: Lyles closed Monday's 127-125 overtime loss to the Cavaliers with three points (1-1 FG, 1-1 3Pt), one rebound and one assist in 13 minutes.
3136196.s: Lyles played a limited role despite the overtime contest, attempting just one shot. The veteran forward has logged fewer than 20 minutes in each of his first four appearances this season, leaving him with minimal fantasy appeal outside exceptionally deep leagues.

3136196.s: Lyles will start for the resting Jaden McDaniels on Saturday. Cody Williams will also have the chance for quality minutes in Saturday's exhibition with Jonathan Kuminga (rest) and Anthony Edwards (rest) also unavailable.

3136196.s: The 30-year-old forward returns to the NBA after spending last season with Real Madrid, where he averaged 13.5 points and 4.5 rebounds in EuroLeague competition. Lyles signed a one-year deal with Minnesota in July and appears willing to embrace a mentorship role, though he could also contribute to the Timberwolves' frontcourt rotation following the offseason departures of Julius Randle and Naz Reid.

3137259.h: Vincent is available to make his season debut in Monday's game against the Spurs, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

3137259.s: Vincent is set to join Sacramento to help provide veteran backcourt depth behind rookie Darius Acuff. He'll be making his 2026-27 season debut whenever he takes the court for the Kings.

4066993.s: Smith made both of his attempts from beyond the arc while providing a steal in his limited playing time. 4222252.s: The veteran center was nearly perfect from the field and controlled the glass, giving Oklahoma City the interior presence it badly needs with Chet Holmgren (knee) sidelined. Hartenstein has been asked to do more as both a scorer and a playmaker during this injury stretch, and Friday was one of his best all-around efforts of the season. Pairing him with Aday Mara in a jumbo lineup has helped the Thunder hold their…

4222252.h: Hartenstein delivered 20 points (10-14 FG), 11 rebounds, six assists and two steals across 34 minutes in Wednesday's 118-108 loss to the Trail Blazers.

His six assists and two steals added valuable secondary contributions, though six turnovers hurt his efficiency. Hartenstein's ability to contribute across multiple categories makes him particularly valuable in category-based formats, but this was a much-needed bounce-back…

4222252.h: Hartenstein registered two points (1-4 FG), six rebounds, seven assists, one block and one steal in 26 minutes during Friday's 128-97 victory over Memphis.
4222252.s: Hartenstein scored no more than five points for the third straight game, although he did manage to contribute across most categories. Even with Chet Holmgren (knee) sidelined, Hartenstein has been somewhat underwhelming. 4222252.h: Hartenstein closed Monday's 117-112 victory over the Cavaliers with five points (2-8 FG, 1-2 FT), 14 rebounds, four assists and two steals across 28 minutes.
4222252.s: Hartenstein struggled to find his touch offensively but made his presence felt elsewhere, pulling down seven offensive rebounds while leading both teams in total boards. The veteran center continues to provide fantasy value through his rebounding, passing and defensive contributions, even when his scoring is limited.

4222252.s: It was the third straight double-double for Hartenstein, who's been handling a bigger role in the frontcourt while Chet Holmgren (knee) is on the mend. 4277905.h: Young ended with 11 points (2-9 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 6-7 FT), one rebound, eight assists and one steal across 32 minutes during Wednesday's 103-99 win over the Raptors.

4277905.h: Young tallied 13 points (3-10 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 12 assists, two rebounds and two steals over 33 minutes in Monday's 136-120 loss to Memphis.

The 28-year-old has reached the 20-point mark in three of his last five outings and has knocked down at least three…

In four outings so far this month, Young has averaged 15.0 points, 7.0 assists, 3.0 rebounds and 1.3 steals across 33.3 minutes per contest.

4277956.h: Poole finished with 14 points (5-8 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-4 FT), an assist and a block across 21 minutes in Wednesday's 145-111 loss to the Nets.

4398207.s: Slawson had three combined steals and blocks in just 14 minutes, a reminder to managers of his upside on that end of the floor. At this point, his role is too insignificant to warrant attention outside of deeper leagues. However, if he should ever carve out a consistent 24-minute per-night role, he would definitely be on the streaming radar.

4398207.h: Slawson will come off the bench in Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
4398207.s: Pascal Siakam is back after resting Monday, so Slawson will head back to the second unit. As a reserve this season, Slawson is averaging 2.7 points and 3.0 rebounds per game.

4398207.h: Slawson ended with 12 points (3-11 FG, 2-7 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven rebounds, three assists, three blocks and three steals over 41 minutes during Monday's 108-104 loss to Atlanta.
4398207.s: Slawson struggled with his shot but compensated with a standout defensive effort, matching his three steals with three blocks. Indiana's severely depleted roster allowed him to play more than 40 minutes, creating an unusually favorable environment for counting stats. He could offer short-term streaming value for managers seeking defensive production, though his role remains dependent on the Pacers' injury situation.

4398207.h: Slawson will start in Monday's game against the Hawks, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4398207.s: Slawson will enter the starting lineup for the first time this season with Indiana dressing just eight players.

4398207.h: Slawson registered two points (2-2 FT), one rebound, one assist, one block and one steal in 12 minutes during Wednesday's 114-109 loss to the 76ers.
4398207.s: Slawson played double-digit minutes for the second time this season, providing serviceable defensive contributions. Indiana is without both Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) and Ivica Zubac (ankle), meaning there are minutes up for grabs. Should Slawson manage to carve out a 20-minute per-night role for himself, he could make sense as a defensive streamer, even in standard formats.

4398207.h: Slawson went scoreless (0-5 FG, 0-5 3Pt) but collected five rebounds, three assists, two blocks and one steal across 33 minutes in Tuesday's 114-112 preseason overtime loss to Oklahoma City.
4398207.s: Slawson logged more minutes than any other Indiana player, giving the coaching staff an extended look at his versatility. Although his perimeter jumper deserted him, he remained active defensively and contributed as a passer. The uneven outing followed a more productive offensive showing against Atlanta, underscoring the consistency he'll need to establish to earn regular minutes.

4398207.h: Slawson managed 12 points (4-5 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 3-6 FT), two rebounds and one steal in 13 minutes during Saturday's 119-117 preseason loss to the Hawks.
4398207.s: Slawson was efficient from the field in his limited playing time, finishing as Indiana's third-leading scorer while pacing the second unit. The 26-year-old forward is on a two-way pact and figures to spend the majority of his time with Indiana's G League affiliate, the Noblesville Boom, in 2026-27.

4431671.h: McDaniels finished with 32 points (11-15 FG, 4-5 3Pt, 6-6 FT), 10 rebounds, five assists, one steal and one block across 37 minutes in Wednesday's 113-106 win over Oklahoma City.

4431671.h: McDaniels recorded 17 points (6-10 FG, 4-4 3Pt, 1-1 FT), four rebounds, one assist, two blocks and two steals across 39 minutes during Thursday's 102-99 loss to the Knicks.

4431671.h: McDaniels finished Monday's 106-98 victory over Portland with 13 points (5-11 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 3-3 FT), six rebounds, three assists, two blocks and two steals over 31 minutes.

The veteran forward also made his presence felt on the defensive end, where he racked up at least three combined steals-plus-blocks for the third time in his last five games. During that span, he's averaged 17.2 points, 6.4 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 2.6 combined steals-plus-blocks in 33.2 minutes per contest. McDaniels…

4431671.s: McDaniels was one of Minnesota's few efficient offensive performers, and his six assists were particularly encouraging for a forward who typically contributes more through scoring and defense. He has now scored 16 and 18 points in his last two outings, respectively, while continuing to see substantial minutes. With Anthony Edwards (knee) sidelined, McDaniels has additional opportunities to contribute offensively,…

4432185.s: Peavy will get his first start as a member of the Thunder and fifth of his career Sunday due to numerous rotation players being sidelined. He should be in line for a heavy workload.

4432185.h: Peavy will start in Friday's game against New Orleans, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
4432185.s: Peavy will start for the first time in 2026-27. The 25-year-old has appeared in nine regular-season games, averaging 3.4 points and 3.3 rebounds over 16.4 minutes per contest. With Peavy in the starting five, Aday Mara will revert to the bench.

4432185.h: Micah Peavy SG OKC - Off the Bench - Friday vs NOR
Peavy finished Wednesday's 124-116 win over the Cavaliers with two points (1-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt), nine rebounds, one assist and one steal over 26 minutes.
4432185.s: Peavy pulled down a season-high nine rebounds Wednesday. The banged-up Thunder are searching for consistency from their role players, but Peavy is a two-way player and could be headed to the G League's Oklahoma City Blue in the coming days or weeks.

4432185.h: Peavy agreed to a two-way contract with the Thunder on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432185.s: The Grizzlies cut Peavy loose while he tended to an ankle injury during training camp, but it didn't take particularly long for the forward to find another home. Peavy is replacing Otega Oweh (Achilles), who was waived earlier Friday, on the Thunder's roster.

4432185.h: Memphis waived Peavy (ankle) on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4432185.s: An ankle injury cost Peavy the end of the preseason, which might have played a part in him winding up on the chopping block for the Grizzlies. The 2025 second-rounder is now looking to find a home elsewhere as frontcourt depth.

4432185.h: Head coach Tuomas Iisalo said Thursday that Peavy (ankle) has progressed well in his recovery, though he won't play in Friday's preseason finale against Charlotte, Anthony Sain of Buff City Media reports.
4432185.s: Peavy will end up missing the entirety of the preseason due to an ankle injury. His next opportunity to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Jazz.

4432185.h: Peavy (ankle) did not see the floor in Friday's 104-100 preseason win over the Bulls.
4432185.s: Peavy missed a third consecutive contest due to an ankle injury. His final chance to play in the preseason will come next Friday against Charlotte.

4432185.h: Peavy (ankle) did not play in Wednesday's 122-118 preseason loss to the Magic.
4432185.s: This was Peavy's second straight game on the sidelines, and it's unclear if he'll play during the preseason. His next chance to suit up will come Friday in Chicago.

4432194.h: Day'Ron Sharpe supplies 11-14-5, three steals & two blocks vs. Bucks
Sharpe produced six points (2-5 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), five rebounds, seven assists and one steal across 26 minutes before fouling out of Monday's 142-116 loss to the Timberwolves.
4432194.s: Sharpe continues to demonstrate improved playmaking, with Monday's assist total exceeding his season average of 4.1 per game. His ability to facilitate from the center position adds fantasy value, particularly in deeper category leagues.

4432194.h: Sharpe closed Friday's 113-111 loss to Orlando with 17 points (7-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 11 rebounds, two assists, one block and one steal over 26 minutes.
4432194.s: Sharpe had combined for 12 points in his previous two appearances, but he was more involved in the offense Friday and notched a season-high 17 points while securing his fourth double-double of the season. Sharpe has been hit-or-miss this year, but he's still providing late-round value with averages of 9.0 points, 7.4 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.2 blocks per game.

4432194.h: Sharpe accumulated six points (3-4 FG), five rebounds, one assist and one block across 22 minutes during Wednesday's 137-107 loss to the Bulls.
4432194.s: Sharpe failed to take advantage of what should have been a favorable matchup, scoring just six points for the third time in his past five outings. To this point, Sharpe has been a serviceable standard league asset, averaging 8.4 points, 7.1 rebounds, 4.0 assists and 1.2 blocks in 23.6 minutes per game. He remains a hold, although an uptick in his production certainly wouldn't be a bad thing for fantasy managers.

4432194.h: Sharpe finished with 16 points (7-14 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 11 rebounds, five assists and one steal over 28 minutes in Saturday's 129-110 loss to Memphis.
4432194.s: Sharpe ended with a double-double Saturday, his third of the season. While it wasn't an efficient shooting night, it was a productive showing overall from the 25-year-old, who is now averaging 8.8 points, 7.2 rebounds, 4.2 assists and 1.3 blocks, all career highs, across 23.7 minutes per contest in 12 regular-season games.

4432194.h: Noah Clowney starting for Michael Porter Jr.
4432194.s: Egor Demin, Danny Wolf, Noah Clowney, Julius Randle and Day'Ron Sharpe will start against the Grizzlies on Friday.

4432194.h: Sharpe finished with 12 points (4-8 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 4-4 FT), 10 rebounds, 13 assists and one block over 32 minutes in Saturday's 124-121 loss to Atlanta.
4432194.s: The Nets got off to a hot start Saturday night, with Sharpe playing a prominent role in the team's success throughout most of the game. While Brooklyn couldn't hold on to earn its third win of the 2026-27 campaign, Sharpe picked up his first career triple-double while setting a franchise record in assists by a center. He has posted 7.7 points per contest over his nine regular-season appearances, down from his…

4432194.h: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.
4432194.s: Sharpe dominated the glass, collecting four offensive rebounds while shooting efficiently en route to his first double-double of the season. It was also the second time he scored in double digits this season. Sharpe's rebounding provides a useful foundation, although his ceiling will depend on whether Brooklyn consistently gives him enough touches and playing time. He has played more than 25 minutes just twice all…

4432194.h: Sharpe finished Tuesday's 125-124 overtime loss to the Celtics with four points (2-4 FG, 0-1 3Pt), six rebounds, one block and one steal in 17 minutes.
4432194.s: Sharpe started at center but saw limited playing time, with Moritz Wagner logging 22 minutes off the bench. Although Sharpe provided three combined steals and blocks, his modest offensive involvement and reduced minutes were disappointing. The distribution of minutes between Brooklyn's centers will be worth monitoring.

4432241.h: Shead ended with 11 points (4-8 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 0-2 FT), two rebounds, six assists and one block in 26 minutes during Monday's 116-111 loss to Milwaukee.
4432241.s: Shead has recorded at least four assists in 14 consecutive appearances, highlighting his steady playmaking role. While his offensive production remains inconsistent, his season average of 6.3 assists provides value in deeper category leagues.

4432241.h: Shead ended Wednesday's 103-99 loss to the Wizards with 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-3 3Pt), one rebound and six assists across 24 minutes.
4432241.s: Shead has become an increasingly useful source of secondary playmaking for Toronto, recording 16 assists across his last three appearances while scoring in double figures twice during that stretch. Although Immanuel Quickley continues to handle the primary point guard responsibilities, Shead has demonstrated that he can provide offense and facilitate effectively from the second unit. His playing time remains…

4432241.h: Shead registered seven points (2-7 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 2-4 FT) and six assists over 20 minutes during Tuesday's 111-102 loss to New York.
4432241.s: Shead continues to provide steady playmaking off Toronto's bench, recording at least four assists in each of his last four appearances. While his scoring remains inconsistent, his ability to facilitate the offense gives him some fantasy appeal as an assists specialist in deeper leagues.

4432241.h: Shead had 19 points (7-12 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 2-3 FT), two rebounds and four assists over 26 minutes during Sunday's 112-108 overtime loss to the Knicks.
4432241.s: Shead provided Toronto with a welcome scoring boost off the bench, connecting on three triples while reaching 19 points. This was his third game with double-digit points in his last five appearances. His offensive role remains secondary to the Raptors' established starters, particularly with Scottie Barnes back in the lineup, but his ability to create opportunities for himself and his teammates gives him some appeal…

4432241.h: Shead won't start Wednesday's game against Boston, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4432241.s: Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) will return to the lineup Wednesday, pushing Shead to the bench. The third-year floor general has averaged 5.5 points, 5.4 assists, 2.0 rebounds and 1.4 steals in 21.5 minutes per tilt across eight appearances off the bench this season.

4432241.h: Shead delivered 20 points (6-17 FG, 4-10 3Pt, 4-4 FT), two rebounds, 11 assists and two steals across 36 minutes during Monday's 118-102 loss to the Grizzlies.
4432241.s: Shead started his second straight game and notched consecutive double-doubles after he posted 10 points (4-10 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 1-2 FT) and a career-high 16 dimes in Friday's 121-107 victory over Milwaukee. Shead has taken advantage of his opportunities in the first unit with Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) on the shelf, and that is likely to continue for as long as the latter is sidelined. Shead offers plenty of streaming…

4432241.h: Shead delivered 10 points (4-10 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three rebounds, 16 assists and two steals in Friday's 121-107 win over the Bucks.
4432241.s: Shead got the start due to the absence of Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and made the most of the opportunity, dishing out a career-high mark in assists and also recording his sixth consecutive game with at least six dimes. The third-year floor general has one of the best assists-per-minute ratios in the league, averaging 6.3 assists per game despite playing 25 minutes or fewer in all but one of his nine appearances…

4432241.h: Shead will start Friday against the Bucks, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4432241.s: Shead will get his first start of the season with Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) unavailable. As a starter during the 2025-26 regular season, Shead averaged 11.5 points, 7.5 assists, 1.8 triples, 1.3 steals and just 1.6 turnovers per contest on 41/40/84 shooting splits.

4432241.h: Shead racked up nine points (3-6 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 1-1 FT), two rebounds, six assists and three steals in 25 minutes during Sunday's 131-125 loss to the Lakers.
4432241.s: Shead made an impact as a distributor and defender, collecting three steals (his high for the season) while matching his scoring output with six assists. His ability to generate assists and defensive stats gives him some appeal in deeper leagues, although his offensive role remains relatively limited.

4432241.h: Shead posted 13 points (4-7 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 4-4 FT), seven assists, four rebounds and two steals over 23 minutes during Wednesday's 129-99 win over Orlando.
4432241.s: Shead's 13 points led all Raptors bench players Wednesday, and his seven dimes were tied with Immanuel Quickley for most on the team. It was Shead's first double-digit scoring effort of the season, and he'll continue to lead Toronto's second unit as the backup to Quickley.

4432247.h: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for at least two weeks.
4432247.s: Clark suffered a right hamstring strain during Saturday's 117-106 loss to Chicago. He played three minutes as a result of the injury, and he's now slated to miss at least two weeks and will be re-evaluated at that time. Terrence Shannon and Bones Hyland will see increased playing time off the bench in Clark's absence.

4432247.h: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Saturday's game against the Bulls, Sarah Todd of The Deseret News reports.
4432247.s: Clark tweaked his right hamstring and will not return to Saturday's contest. He played three minutes off the bench prior to his exit. Clark's departure leaves more opportunities available for Terrence Shannon Jr. and Bones Hyland.

4432247.h: Clark had seven points (3-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt), six rebounds, two assists and one steal across 19 minutes during Thursday's 133-94 win over the Mavericks.
4432247.s: Clark is playing a steady role off the bench for Minnesota, but he's not been productive enough to warrant much fantasy attention in Anthony Edwards' (knee) absence. Over his last seven outings, Clark has averaged 6.7 points, 2.7 rebounds and 1.3 steals in 20.2 minutes per game.

4432247.h: Clark accumulated four points (1-6 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 1-2 FT), two rebounds and two steals in 21 minutes during Monday's 112-100 victory over Milwaukee.
4432247.s: Clark struggled from the field but provided defensive energy in a reserve role. With Anthony Edwards (knee) and Terrence Shannon (hip) sidelined, Clark has an opportunity to maintain a spot in Minnesota's backcourt rotation. However, his limited offensive involvement makes him primarily a steals specialist in deeper fantasy formats.

4432247.h: Clark will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4432247.s: Clark started in the Timberwolves preseason finale with Anthony Edwards (rest) taking the night off, but Edwards is back and starting on Opening Night. As a reserve last season, Clark averaged 4.0 points in 12.8 minutes per game.

4432247.h: Clark finished with 18 points (6-12 FG, 3-8 3Pt, 3-6 FT), seven rebounds, three steals and one block over 29 minutes in Friday's 133-116 preseason loss to Chicago.
4432247.s: Clark tied Drew Timme to finish second on the team in points behind Isaiah Evans, who ended the night with a game-high 21 points. Outside of the 25-year-old's contributions on the scoring end, he also shined defensively. Clark has appeared in 108 regular-season games for Minnesota since entering the league as the No. 53 overall pick in the 2023 NBA Draft, averaging 4.1 points and 1.6 rebounds across 13.1 minutes per…

4432247.h: Clark will start Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls.
4432247.s: Clark will draw his second preseason start with all of Minnesota's regulars resting. He'll be joined by Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Cody Williams and Joan Beringer.

4432247.h: Clark will start in Saturday's exhibition against the Heat.
4432247.s: Jaden McDaniels (rest) and Jonathan Kuminga (rest) are out, so Clark will be thrust into the starting unit for Saturday's exhibition. Clark earned one start last season and finished with eight points, three rebounds, two assists, two triples and one block over 30 minutes.

4432247.h: Clark faces a more difficult path to consistent minutes following Minnesota's addition of Jonathan Kuminga.
4432247.s: Clark currently provides depth at shooting guard and small forward, but Kuminga's expected starting role might push Ayo Dosunmu into a more prominent reserve role while occupying substantial minutes at the forward spots. Clark's defensive ability should keep him in consideration for situational minutes, though he's unlikely to enter the season with a significant fantasy role.

4432446.h: Walker is in the starting lineup for Monday's game against Portland, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
4432446.s: Walker is making his second start of the season for the 76ers on Monday. With Joel Embiid ailing, Walker is working in a timeshare with Dominick Barlow and Adem Bona at center.

4432446.h: Walker ended with 12 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT), five rebounds, one assist and one block in 16 minutes during Monday's 135-123 win over Brooklyn.
4432446.s: With Joel Embiid (foot) back in the lineup Monday, Walker moved to the bench. However, he still delivered an efficient performance en route to a season-high-tying 12 points. The 24-year-old has averaged 8.5 points and 6.7 rebounds in 18.0 minutes per showing over his last six appearances (one start), and he should continue seeing increased minutes for as long as Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back) are…

4432446.h: Walker is not listed in the starting lineup for Monday's game against the Nets, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
4432446.s: Walker will head back to the bench with Joel Embiid (foot) returning to the starting lineup versus Brooklyn. LeBron James (back/rest) won't play the second half of Philadelphia's back-to-back set, meaning Walker should still see steady playing time as a reserve.

4432446.h: Walker ended with 11 points (4-8 FG, 3-6 3Pt), seven rebounds, one assist and one steal across 25 minutes during Sunday's 131-124 victory over Indiana.
4432446.s: The 76ers awarded Walker with a season-high workload amid the absences of Joel Embiid (foot), Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back) on Sunday. That said, Walker is all but certain to revert back to the bench if Embiid suits up for the second leg of this back-to-back set in Brooklyn on Monday.

4432446.h: Walker will start in Sunday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
4432446.s: With Joel Embiid (right foot injury management), Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back) all sidelined for Sunday's meeting with the Pacers, Walker will enter the starting lineup for the first time this season. The 24-year-old started six regular-season games during the 2025-26 campaign, averaging 2.5 points and 3.3 rebounds over 14.0 minutes per contest in those appearances.

4432446.h: Walker produced nine points (4-8 FG, 1-2 3Pt) and 11 rebounds across 19 minutes during Sunday's 127-121 victory over the Bulls.
4432446.s: The 11 boards were easily a season best for Walker, who gave the 76ers a nice lift off the bench Sunday. The 19 minutes also matched a season high, but the 24-year-old forward is likely to struggle for consistent fantasy appeal while the 76ers are healthy in the frontcourt.

4432446.h: Walker supplied 12 points (5-8 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 1-1 FT) and six rebounds across 19 minutes during Saturday's 109-104 win over Charlotte.
4432446.s: After missing Philadelphia's previous three games with a knee injury, Walker returned and made a noticeable impact with LeBron James and Joel Embiid inactive. Walker posted season highs in minutes, points and rebounds to help the Sixers win their third straight contest. However, when Philadelphia is healthy, his playing time will shrink substantially.

4432446.h: Walker (knee) is available for Saturday's game versus the Hornets, Chris Hine of The Philly Inquirer reports.
4432446.s: Walker missed the last three games but will return for Saturday's meeting with Charlotte. The 24-year-old has averaged just 6.3 minutes this season. However, with LeBron James (rest), Dominick Barlow (back) and Joel Embiid (foot) sidelined, Walker might see a little more action.

4432446.h: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.
4432446.s: Walker will miss a third consecutive contest due to a left knee issue. His next opportunity to suit up will come Saturday at Charlotte in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

4432446.h: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.
4432446.s: Walker will miss a second consecutive contest due to left knee soreness. According to Ky Carlin of USA Today, the 24-year-old forward didn't practice Tuesday but was able to go through individual on-court workouts. His next chance to play will come Friday against New York.

4432573.h: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432573.s: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.

4432573.h: Banchero didn't check back in during the fourth quarter of Friday's 115-93 loss to the Timberwolves after being deemed doubtful to return. He finished with 14 points (5-11 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 2-4 FT), six rebounds, five assists and one steal across 26 minutes.
4432573.s: Banchero exited to the locker room in the third quarter after tweaking his right ankle. He briefly returned to action in the third but didn't see the floor in the fourth due to ankle soreness. The star forward can be considered questionable for Sunday's game at New York until the Magic offer an update on his status.

4432573.h: Banchero (ankle) has checked back into Friday's game against the Timberwolves, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Banchero tweaked his ankle coming down from a rebound, but after getting checked up in the locker room, he's been cleared to return. He's off to a hot start, scoring 14 points on eight shots in his first 23 minutes of play.

4432573.h: Banchero exited Friday's game against the Timberwolves and went to the locker room after appearing to have tweaked his ankle, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.
4432573.s: Banchero appeared to tweak his ankle when he and Jalen Suggs went crashing in for a rebound early in the third quarter, and the former departed straight to the locker room. Losing Banchero would be huge for Orlando, as he scored 14 points on 6-for-7 shooting before leaving. If he doesn't return, Tristan da Silva could be in line for a bigger role in the frontcourt.

4432573.h: Banchero ended with 35 points (10-12 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 12-16 FT), seven rebounds, 10 assists and one steal over 41 minutes in Wednesday's 132-125 loss to Atlanta.
4432573.s: Despite accumulating six turnovers, Banchero had a fantastic Opening Night, becoming the first player in franchise history to finish with at least 30 points and 10 assists while shooting a minimum of 75.0 percent from the field. The 2022 No. 1 overall pick averaged 22.2 points, 5.2 assists and a career-best 8.5 rebounds in 2025-26. He shot a career-low 30.5 percent from deep, though he played in 72 regular-season…

4432573.h: Banchero finished with 24 points (5-11 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 13-16 FT), seven rebounds, four assists and one block in 26 minutes during Friday's 136-115 preseason win over Miami.
4432573.s: Banchero dropped 24 points for the second straight game, impressively getting to the line 16 times. As a high-volume scorer, Banchero's inefficiency has been a major talking point throughout his career. Nights like this give us a glimpse of what he can do when his shots are falling. However, fantasy managers may be wise to err on the side of caution when considering him in drafts. For those in category leagues, he…

4432573.h: Banchero supplied 24 points (10-13 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), eight rebounds, three assists and one steal across 28 minutes in Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over Cleveland.
4432573.s: Banchero delivered a bounce-back performance Tuesday after shooting just 1-for-10 from the field in Sunday's loss to the Cavaliers. The star forward turned in an extremely efficient performance in Tuesday's rematch, finishing with a game-high 24 points. He was also productive on the glass, pacing all players in rebounds.

4432573.h: Banchero ended with 10 points (1-10 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 7-10 FT), seven rebounds, two assists and one block over 18 minutes in Sunday's 119-105 preseason loss to Cleveland.
4432573.s: Banchero had his second consecutive double-digit preseason scoring performance. However, he had trouble finding the net once again Sunday and has now shot a combined 3-for-17 from the field in his first two preseason appearances. Banchero is coming off a productive 2025-26 campaign, averaging 22.2 points, 5.2 assists and a career-high 8.4 rebounds over 34.8 minutes per contest. He also appeared in 72 regular-season…

4432573.h: Banchero supplied 11 points (2-7 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 7-10 FT), one rebound and five assists across 15 minutes in Wednesday's 122-118 preseason win over the Grizzlies.
4432573.s: Banchero struggled from the field but got to the line 10 times and repeatedly set up Wendell Carter and Desmond Bane while playing only two quarters. The offense ran primarily through Franz Wagner, with Banchero often working off the ball, a scheme that could ultimately help the Duke product's bottom line after logging a regression in his scoring average last season.

4432573.h: Banchero drew praise from teammate Wendell Carter on Monday for the work he put in during the offseason, with Carter saying the star forward is "looking like young Paolo," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Carter described Banchero as "very springy" and "very bouncy" after seeing him work out this summer, an encouraging assessment of his conditioning and athleticism heading into training camp. Banchero also said Monday that new head coach Sean Sweeney made an immediate effort to build a relationship with him after being hired, including traveling to Seattle to spend time with the 23-year-old during the offseason.

4432582.h: Christie notched 13 points (5-7 FG, 3-4 3Pt), four rebounds, one block and three steals across 24 minutes during Saturday's 110-100 win over the Clippers.
4432582.s: Christie continues to come off the bench, having dealt with hip and ankle injuries during the month of November. While he does provide Dallas with a semi-reliable floor-spacing option, there simply isn't enough meat on the bone when it comes to his overall production to warrant serious attention. In 13 appearances thus far, Christie has averaged just 5.8 points and 1.2 three-pointers in 18.1 minutes per game.

4432582.h: Christie (ankle) is listed as available for Wednesday's game against Golden State.
4432582.s: Christie missed the last two games due to an ankle injury. It's unclear if he will enter the starting lineup, though he will presumably see his usual workload either way. The 23-year-old has struggled during the 2026-27 campaign, averaging 5.3 points, 2.9 rebounds and 1.2 assists while shooting 27.3 percent from deep over 18.5 minutes per contest in 11 regular-season appearances.

4432582.h: Christie (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
4432582.s: It's worth noting that Christie was a full practice participant Tuesday. His return from a two-game absence caused by an ankle sprain would likely lead to less playing time for Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher on the wing.

4432582.h: Max Christie, Santi Aldama get in full practice
4432582.s: Mavs beat writer Mike Curtis reports that Max Christie (ankle) and Santi Aldama (ankle) got in full practices Tuesday.

4432582.h: Christie (ankle) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4432582.s: Christie sat out Dallas' last two games but is trending in the right direction before Wednesday's meeting with the Warriors. He's averaged just 9.5 minutes per game in his last four appearances, but the swingman's return would still leave fewer minutes available for Caleb Martin and Zaccharie Risacher.

4432582.h: Christie (ankle) is doubtful to play Sunday's game against the Celtics.
4432582.s: A sprained left ankle forced Christie to miss Saturday's 127-117 loss to Cleveland, and he's in serious danger of missing a second consecutive outing with the ailment. If Christie sits again, Naji Marshall, Zaccharie Risacher and Walter Clayton Jr. will divvy up the vacated minutes.

4432582.h: Christie (ankle) has been downgraded to doubtful for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers.
4432582.s: Christie was initially listed as questionable for Saturday's contest due to a left ankle sprain, but it now appears likely that he'll miss the front end of his back-to-back set. Zaccharie Risacher and Naji Marshall stand to benefit from extra playing time if Christie sits.

4432582.h: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.
4432582.s: Christie is at risk of missing the front end of this back-to-back set with a lingering injury. His absence would result in an uptick in playing time for Zaccharie Risacher and Naji Marshall, which would bolster both players' streaming appeal.

4432582.h: Christie (hip) is listed as available for Friday's game against Utah.
4432582.s: Christie exited Monday's meeting with the Kings due to a hip injury and was subsequently ruled out for Wednesday's game versus the Spurs. He will now avoid a second consecutive absence, though it's unknown if he will return to the starting lineup over Zaccharie Risacher.

4432582.h: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.
4432582.s: The swingman is primed to end a one-game absence Friday due to a hip injury. Christie had been starting at shooting guard for the Mavericks before getting hurt, but it remains to be seen if 2024 No. 1 overall pick Zaccharie Risacher has played well enough to keep his hold on a starting job.

4432639.h: Smith recorded 13 points (4-9 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 3-5 FT), four rebounds, one assist, two blocks and one steal over 32 minutes during Wednesday's 116-104 win over the Suns.
4432639.s: Smith has averaged 15.2 points and 5.6 rebounds over his last five appearances while shooting 52.0 percent from the field. His steady minutes and ability to contribute three-pointers and defensive stats support his value in standard fantasy formats.

4432639.h: Smith finished with 13 points (6-11 FG, 1-4 3Pt), six rebounds and two assists in 28 minutes during Monday's 116-104 win over the Clippers.
4432639.s: Smith took a step back and failed to reach the 15-point mark for the first time in his last three appearances after he struggled with his outside shot. With Kevin Durant, Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson usually on the floor alongside him, Smith doesn't need to shoulder a heavy scoring burden, but that also limits his opportunities to deliver explosive offensive performances. His role as a secondary option in…

4432639.h: Smith had 21 points (7-8 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 4-5 FT), four rebounds and three assists over 32 minutes during Friday's 133-124 loss to the Nuggets.
4432639.s: Smith was nearly perfect from the field, marking two straight strong games after a cold stretch earlier in the week. The forward has been one of Houston's most reliable outside shooters this season, hitting more than 40 percent of his threes.

4432639.h: Smith provided 17 points (7-10 FG, 3-6 3Pt), four rebounds, two assists and one block across 26 minutes during Wednesday's 119-104 victory over the Pacers.
4432639.s: Smith had been mired in a four-game shooting funk, but he was remarkably efficient Wednesday, missing just three shots. He'll look to carry his momentum into Friday's meeting with the Nuggets.

4433137.s: Williams gave the Lakers useful minutes off the bench, knocking down a pair of three-pointers and picking up two steals in his 20 minutes. The forward missed three straight games with soreness in his left foot, an issue going back to the preseason, before being cleared to return earlier in the week. The Lakers begin a back-to-back Sunday, so he could be held out for one of those games.

4433137.h: Williams contributed 10 points (3-7 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 3-3 FT), four rebounds, one assist and two steals in 23 minutes during Wednesday's 116-103 victory over the Kings.
4433137.s: After beginning the year as a starter, Williams seems to be getting eased back into action following a recent absence. He'll continue competing with Jake LaRavia for the Lakers' fifth starting lineup position.

4433137.h: Williams notched nine points (3-6 FG, 3-6 3Pt), two rebounds, two assists and one steal over 15 minutes during Monday's 138-117 win over the Heat.
4433137.s: Williams returned from a three-game absence due to a foot injury, but he operated off the bench for the first time this season and played limited minutes. Over his first four appearances, the sixth-year wing averaged 11.3 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.5 steals in 28.5 minutes per game.

4433137.h: Williams won't start Monday's game against the Heat, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
4433137.s: Williams is returning from a three-game absence due to a foot injury, though he'll slide to the second unit for the first time this season. Jake LaRavia will draw a fourth consecutive start.

4433144.h: Love supplied 15 points (4-10 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 4-6 FT), three rebounds, six assists and two blocks across 23 minutes off the bench in Monday's 120-97 preseason win over the Knicks.
4433144.s: Love ranked second on the team in both points and assists, and the promising playmaker made a good impression in his first taste of preseason action. The two-way guard faces plenty of competition for regular-season opportunities in Philadelphia's backcourt, but his combination of shotmaking and secondary playmaking made for an encouraging preseason showing.

4433149.h: Cryer will come off the bench Thursday night against Memphis.
4433149.s: Cryer has struggled in a pair of starts for Golden State, so the team is making a change to the first unit. De'Anthony Melton is getting the nod at point guard Thursday while Cryer slides to the bench.

4433149.h: Cryer (back) is available for Thursday's game against Grizzlies.
4433149.s: Cryer was added to the injury report as questionable earlier in the day due to a back issue, but he's since been cleared to suit up for Thursday's contest. The 25-year-old has started each of the Warriors' last two games, though he's been held to only 16 total points over that brief stretch.

4433149.h: Cryer will start in Monday's game against New Orleans, Dalton Johnson of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4433149.s: Cryer will earn his first start of the season after erupting for a team-high 20 points and six threes off the bench during Friday's 123-85 loss to the Spurs. Over his last three outings, Cryer is averaging 14.3 points, 3.3 assists and 3.7 triples in 20.7 minutes.

4433149.h: Cryer logged 20 points (7-17 FG, 6-11 3Pt), two rebounds, six assists and one steal over 24 minutes during Friday's 123-85 loss to the Spurs.
4433149.s: Cryer was the one bright spot for Golden State, leading the team with 20 points and hitting six threes off the bench. With Stephen Curry (oblique) expected to miss at least two weeks, the Warriors need extra support, and Cryer made a strong case Friday, even if most of it came after the game was decided. He should get a bigger role Monday at New Orleans.

4433149.h: Cryer ended with 10 points (4-9 FG, 2-6 3Pt) and three assists in 20 minutes during Monday's 138-87 victory over the Pelicans.
4433149.s: Cryer picked up meaningful minutes in a blowout win due to Will Richard (thumb) and Gary Payton (knee) being unavailable, and he knocked down a pair of triples. Cryer is unlikely to hold fantasy value outside of deep leagues once Golden State's backcourt gets healthy.

4433149.h: Cryer posted six points (2-3 FG, 2-2 3Pt) and two assists across three minutes during Monday's 134-114 victory over Denver.
4433149.s: Cryer saw a bit of garbage-time run in this blowout win. With Golden State's backcourt fully healthy, Cryer lacks a clear path to playing time in the early going.

4433174.h: Cardwell will come off the bench during Wednesday's game against the Suns.
4433174.s: Cardwell got the start Sunday due to many regular starters being sidelined, but he will return to a bench role Wednesday. Over his last four appearances, Cardwell has averaged 5.3 points, 7.3 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.0 blocks in 19.8 minutes per contest.

4433174.s: Cardwell is slated for his second start of the season due to the absences of Zach LaVine (illness), De'Andre Hunter (hip) and Precious Achiuwa (ankle). Cardwell will start alongside Darius Acuff, Malik Monk, Keegan Murray and Domantas Sabonis.

4433174.h: Cardwell finished with one point (0-3 FG, 1-1 FT), 11 rebounds, one assist, two blocks and two steals across 29 minutes during Tuesday's 107-100 loss to the Magic.
4433174.s: Cardwell couldn't get anything going on offense, but he dominated the glass and made an impact defensively in his bench minutes. With Domantas Sabonis (knee) limited and Precious Achiuwa (lower leg) and Maxime Raynaud (knee) both on the injury report, the second-year center could see more frontcourt minutes in the short term.

4433174.h: Cardwell will start in Sunday's game against the Heat.

4433174.h: Cardwell provided four points (2-3 FG), six rebounds and one steal across 13 minutes during Wednesday's 116-103 loss to the Lakers.
4433174.s: Cardwell made an impact on the glass despite limited playing time, grabbing four offensive rebounds while committing just one foul. The reserve center also finished with a plus-four rating, though Domantas Sabonis' established role continues to restrict his opportunities. Cardwell's rebounding ability is encouraging, but his modest minutes leave him with little appeal outside of deeper fantasy formats.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) is not listed on the injury report for Wednesday's meeting with the Lakers.
4433174.s: It appears Cardwell will be making his regular-season debut Wednesday evening, which could translate to fewer minutes for Precious Achiuwa. Cardwell showed last season he's capable of racking up the defensive stats when given the minutes, but his upside will be muted as long as Domantas Sabonis is healthy.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) has been downgraded to questionable for Monday's game against Dallas.
4433174.s: Cardwell was initially listed as questionable before being upgraded to probable, though it's now less certain that he'll make his season debut. If the 24-year-old big man is cleared to play, there would be fewer minutes available for Jonathan Mogbo.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against the Mavericks.
4433174.s: Cardwell has yet to appear in a game this season while recovering from a left calf strain, and he's in danger of missing his seventh consecutive outing to begin the 2026-27 campaign. If Cardwell remains sidelined, Precious Achiuwa and Jonathan Mogbo are likely to continue earning additional minutes.

4433174.h: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4433174.s: Cardwell is progressing well in his recovery from a calf strain. Precious Achiuwa should remain worth streaming in all fantasy leagues for the banged-up Kings in the meantime.

4433174.s: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries. Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.

4433188.h: Carter finished Sunday's 131-94 win over the Mavericks with zero points (0-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt), two rebounds and one assist in 12 minutes.
4433188.s: Carter made his Celtics debut in Sunday's lopsided victory, though he didn't make much of an impact. The two-way player figures to spend the majority of his time with the G League's Maine Celtics this season.

4433188.s: Carter is working back from mononucleosis, which has prevented him from making his season debut. A two-way player, Carter figures to begin his season in Maine as opposed to Boston once healthy.

4433188.s: Carter missed Boston's final three preseason games with the illness and is now expected to miss time to begin the regular season. He can be considered week-to-week until Boston provides an update on his progress. The 2024 first-rounder signed a two-way pact with the Celtics on Saturday and will provide backcourt depth for the club.

Since then, he appeared in 74 regular-season games with the Kings, including 12 starts, averaging 6.4 points, 2.7 rebounds and 1.9 assists over 14.8 minutes per contest. Carter might have some untapped potential left, though he has a way to go before earning a meaningful role with the Celtics.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game versus the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports
4433188.s: Carter will miss a third consecutive contest due to an illness. The 2024 first-rounder is signed to a non-guaranteed deal and could be let go before the Celtics' regular-season opener against the Pistons on Tuesday.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Charlotte, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
4433188.s: Carter will miss a second consecutive game due to an illness. His next chance to suit up could come Friday against Philadelphia.

4433188.h: Carter (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's exhibition game against the 76ers, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.
4433188.s: Carter played 25 minutes during Boston's preseason opener against Cleveland on Thursday, but the third-year pro is under the weather and will not be available for Saturday's contest. His next chance to play is Wednesday against Charlotte.

4433188.h: Carter finished with 17 points (5-9 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 6-6 FT), five rebounds, three assists and two steals in 25 minutes during Thursday's 124-113 preseason win over Cleveland.
4433188.s: Carter made a strong impression in his first preseason appearance with Boston, delivering efficient scoring while contributing on the glass and defensively. He also committed five turnovers, but his offensive production was encouraging. Carter will look to build on the performance as he competes for a roster spot.

4433188.h: Carter agreed to a deal with the Celtics on Monday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4433188.s: This appears to be an Exhibit 10 deal, as Scotto notes that Carter will compete for an NBA roster or two-way contract in training camp. Across 38 regular-season games for the Kings in 2025-26, Carter averaged 8.9 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.7 assists.

4433188.h: The Hawks waived Carter on Friday, Jake Fischer of BleacherReport.com reports.
4433188.s: After coming over from the Kings in an offseason trade, Carter is being let go by Atlanta before getting the chance to report for training camp. The 2024 first-rounder averaged a career-high 8.9 points, 3.3 rebounds, 2.7 assists and 0.9 steals in 18.4 minutes per contest across 38 regular-season appearances for Sacramento in 2025-26, so he should draw some interest on the open market provided he clears waivers.

4433192.h: Eason racked up 10 points (4-8 FG, 2-2 3Pt), four rebounds, four assists and two steals over 22 minutes during Monday's 116-104 win over the Clippers.
4433192.s: Eason has averaged 9.3 points, 4.7 rebounds, 2.7 assists and 1.3 steals in 23.3 minutes over his last three appearances. His reserve role and reduced playing time limit his fantasy ceiling despite consistent defensive contributions.

4433192.h: Eason will come off the bench in Wednesday's game against the Pacers, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.
4433192.s: Amen Thompson (knee) is back and starting after a one-game absence, so Eason will return to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit this season, Eason is averaging 11.2 points, 6.0 rebounds and 1.1 triples per game.

His 30-minute workload was encouraging for a player whose fantasy appeal has often depended on receiving enough opportunities alongside the Rockets' established starters. Eason's combination of rebounding, defensive versatility and improving perimeter shooting gives him…

It was the second double-double of the season for the fifth-year pro, who is averaging 9.3 points, 6.0 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.3 threes, 0.8 blocks and 0.8 steals over 24.7 minutes per game in November.

4433192.h: Eason totaled six points (2-11 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds and one block in 22 minutes during Wednesday's 115-108 victory over the Warriors.
4433192.s: Eason's production has tapered off a bit lately, but he's still chipping in across the board while sharing a prominent bench role alongside Reed Sheppard for the Rockets. Over his past seven appearances, Eason has averaged 8.7 points, 5.9 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.0 blocks in 22.8 minutes per game.

4433192.h: Eason logged nine points (4-10 FG, 1-5 3Pt), six rebounds, one assist and two steals in 24 minutes during Wednesday's 117-107 loss to the Timberwolves.
4433192.s: Eason turned in another decent performance, maintaining top-100 value despite inconsistent playing time. With that said, he is making the most of his time on the floor, averaging 10.2 points, 5.9 rebounds, 0.9 three-pointers and 2.3 combined steals and blocks. He's picked up at least…

4433192.s: Eason made an impact on both ends of the floor, knocking down three triples while matching Alperen Sengun for the team lead in blocks. He also played more minutes than starting guard Amen Thompson, continuing to carve out a substantial role off the bench. Eason's combination of perimeter shooting and defensive production gives him intriguing fantasy upside, particularly if his playing time remains near 30 minutes.

4433192.h: Eason posted 11 points (4-12 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 13 rebounds, two assists and one steal across 26 minutes off the bench during Friday's 116-111 loss to the Mavericks.
4433192.s: It was the first double-double of the season for Eason, who continues to see a big workload in the frontcourt while Steven Adams (calf) and now Alperen Sengun (back) are on the shelf. Both big men are expected to return in the near future, but Eason's role on the second unit should be fairly secure even when the roster is at full strength. Through six games this season, the fifth-year forward is averaging 10.3…
