4433225.s: Kolek was something of an unsung hero off the bench during Wednesday's come-from-behind victory, handing out a team-high nine dimes. He should continue to handle the No. 2 point guard role for as long as Jose Alvarado is on the shelf with an ankle sprain.

4433225.h: Kolek provided zero points (0-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt), three rebounds, nine assists and one steal in 15 minutes during Sunday's 111-102 loss to the Magic.
4433225.s: With Jose Alvarado (ankle) sidelined, Kolek entered the rotation after sitting out New York's first two games and made the most of his opportunity as a facilitator. He led the Knicks with nine assists without committing a turnover, an impressive showing in limited minutes. However, his playing time could decrease once Alvarado returns, making Kolek a speculative fantasy option outside deeper leagues.

4433225.h: Kolek recorded five points (2-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 0-1 FT), five assists, two rebounds and one block in 17 minutes during Monday's preseason loss to the 76ers.
4433225.s: Kolek didn't commit a turnover while leading the Knicks in assists. The third-year guard will continue competing for reserve backcourt minutes during the preseason.

4433247.s: Kuminga has scored in double figures in five straight appearances, averaging 15.6 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.6 assists during that stretch. His consistent starting role provides fantasy stability, though inconsistent perimeter shooting limits his upside.

Kuminga recorded multiple swats for just the second time through 15 appearances this season.

4433247.h: Kuminga (shoulder) is available for Thursday's game against New York.

After carrying a questionable designation throughout the day, he has now been cleared to suit up for the meeting with the defending champs. Terrence Shannon appears to be the most likely candidate to replace Kuminga in the starting lineup, while Trey Lyles and Bones Hyland will both have a chance to claim a larger role.

The forward's next chance to suit up will come Tuesday in a rematch against Portland, though the quick turnaround makes his availability highly questionable pending further updates. Should Kuminga miss time, Terrence Shannon could see an increased…

4433247.s: The 24-year-old forward has been one of the bigger beneficiaries of the shot volume that opened up when Anthony Edwards (knee) was shut down. There could be more meat on the bone for…

Through nine appearances, he has averaged 12.7 points, 5.7 rebounds, 2.9 assists, 2.1 three-pointers and 2.2 combined steals and blocks, good enough…

4433247.h: Kuminga registered eight points (3-8 FG, 2-4 3Pt), 10 rebounds, three assists and four blocks in 33 minutes during Monday's 112-100 victory over the Bucks.
4433247.s: Kuminga struggled to make an offensive impact but compensated with a season-high four blocks and his first double-digit rebounding performance of the campaign. The forward also connected on two triples, providing valuable production in multiple fantasy categories despite scoring in single digits. His defensive contributions were particularly encouraging, though his modest offensive involvement remains worth…

4433249.h: Diabate registered 14 points (5-9 FG, 4-4 FT), 14 rebounds, two assists and one steal over 38 minutes during Wednesday's 107-105 loss to the Bulls.
4433249.s: Diabate's rebounding and secure frontcourt role continue to support his fantasy value. His limited offensive involvement caps his scoring ceiling, but consistent playing time gives him a dependable path to rebounds and defensive production.

4433249.h: Diabate totaled 10 points (3-4 FG, 4-4 FT), 10 rebounds, three assists, two blocks and two steals over 35 minutes during Monday's 117-111 loss to Memphis.
4433249.s: Diabate has recorded at least 10 rebounds in four consecutive games, averaging 13.3 boards and 32.3 minutes during that stretch. His consistent rebounding, defensive contributions and substantial playing time continue to make him a valuable fantasy option despite limited scoring opportunities.

4433249.h: Diabate finished with 21 points (9-12 FG, 3-5 FT), 15 rebounds, two assists and one steal across 30 minutes during Friday's 111-97 loss to Atlanta.
4433249.s: This was Diabate's fourth double-double of the year, and his fourth straight game pulling down double-digit rebounds. He's been providing mid-round value on the season with averages of 9.6 points, 10.6 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.0 blocks per game on 63.4 percent shooting from the field and 70.0 percent at the line.
Moussa Diabaté recorded a double-double on Friday with 21 points (9-of-12 FGs), 15 rebounds, two assists and one steal in a 111-97 loss to the Hawks.

4433249.s: Diabate turned in an efficient scoring line and was one of three Charlotte starters to finish in double figures. He also contributed in a big way on the boards, leading his team in rebounds on the way to his third double-double of the 2026-27 season. It was nice to see Diabate more involved as a rim protector, as he tied his season high in swats after registering one total block in his previous two appearances…

4433249.h: Diabate provided seven points (3-7 FG, 1-2 FT), 13 rebounds, two assists and one block across 32 minutes during Thursday's 101-96 loss to the Suns.
4433249.s: Scoring has never been the main attraction with Diabate, and that hasn't changed this season. Instead, he's developed into a useful specialist by averaging 9.5 rebounds, 1.4 steals and 0.9 blocks while shooting 61.0 percent from the field. Those numbers give him legitimate value in category leagues, particularly for managers who can afford to sacrifice some offensive production in exchange for rebounding and…

However, he was downgraded to doubtful earlier in the day Monday and has since been ruled out. The Michigan product will miss his second straight matchup due to right quadriceps tendinopathy.

4684793.h: Filipowski (back) is likely to settle for a bench role to begin 2026-27 after ending last season as a starter.
4684793.s: Filipowski filled the void left behind by Jusuf Nurkic, who underwent season-ending nose surgery in February, but the Jazz are expected to get reinforcements for Opening Night. Nurkic is the early favorite to start at center. Utah also added Jaxson Hayes to the frontcourt mix, and Jaren Jackson (knee) figures to be healthy when training camp opens this fall, leaving Filipowski with plenty of obstacles to climb to…

4684806.h: Taylor Hendricks PF MEM - Started 2nd Half - (rather than zach edey)
Hendricks closed Monday's 117-111 win over the Hornets with three points (1-5 FG, 1-4 3Pt), four rebounds and one assist across 24 minutes.
4684806.s: Hendricks has averaged 9.2 points, 4.2 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 22.2 minutes over his last five appearances. Despite maintaining a consistent workload, his recent shooting struggles and reserve role limit his reliability in standard fantasy leagues.

4684806.h: Hendricks is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's game against the Timberwolves.
4684806.s: The Grizzlies will shift their frontcourt with the return of Zach Edey and the absence of Cameron Boozer (ankle), but Hendricks will also move back to the bench. He's played off the bench in all but one of his 11 appearances this season, averaging 8.5 points and 3.6 rebounds per contest.

4684806.h: Hendricks closed Thursday's 126-98 win over Golden State with 11 points (4-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 3-3 FT), four steals, one rebound and one assist in 20 minutes.
4684806.s: With Zach Edey (ankle) out for the second leg of this back-to-back, Hendricks got the start at center for the first time this season. The big man racked up a game- and season-high four steals while scoring in double figures for the fourth time in the last five games, during which he's averaged 14.0 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 steals in 21.4 minutes per tilt.

4684806.h: Hendricks will start in Thursday's game against Golden State.
4684806.s: Although Isaiah Stewart (illness) is available, Hendricks is the one who will start in place of Zach Edey (hip). The 22-year-old has played well of late, scoring in double figures in three of his last four appearances.

4684806.h: Hendricks closed with 18 points (6-7 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 5-6 FT), six rebounds, two assists and two blocks over 21 minutes during Wednesday's 124-121 win over Cleveland.
4684806.s: Hendricks has scored at least 18 points in two of his last three games, averaging 13.6 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.0 three-pointers over his last five appearances. His efficiency is encouraging, but fluctuating minutes and limited defensive production make him a speculative option in deeper fantasy leagues.

4684806.h: Hendricks totaled 10 points (3-5 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-3 FT), 12 rebounds, two assists and one steal in 19 minutes during Friday's 142-111 victory over New Orleans.
4684806.s: Hendricks recorded his first double-double of the season, continuing what has been an intriguing run of production. He has now logged double-digit minutes in three straight games, averaging 8.7 points, 5.7 rebounds and 1.3 three-pointers in 15.1 minutes per outing. Managers in deeper formats might want to monitor the situation, just in case he carves out a consistent role off the bench.

4684806.h: Hendricks ended Friday's 128-97 loss to the Thunder with four points (1-2 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT) and two rebounds in four minutes.
4684806.s: Hendricks has yet to play more than seven minutes in any game this season, continuing to hover on the fringe of the rotation. Three of his four appearances have come during garbage time, resulting in little to no fantasy value. In his four games, he has averaged just 2.5 points and 1.3 three-pointers in 4.3 minutes per contest.

4684806.h: Hendricks amassed zero points (0-2 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and one rebound in seven minutes during Sunday's 123-112 win over the Kings.
4684806.s: Hendricks entered the Memphis rotation for the first time this season after going unused off the bench for the team's first two games. However, he appears to be well behind Isaiah Stewart (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game at Utah, Jerami Grant and Quinten Post in the frontcourt pecking order.

4684806.h: Hendricks (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 123-103 win over Utah.
4684806.s: Memphis cruised to an Opening Night victory without needing Hendricks in its rotation. The forward faces competition for frontcourt minutes and will need to establish a more consistent role before generating meaningful fantasy appeal.

4687718.h: Minott notched 10 points (4-10 FG, 2-8 3Pt), two rebounds, one assist, one block and two steals across 12 minutes during Sunday's 130-93 loss to the Mavericks.
4687718.s: Minott made the most of his limited playing time, reaching double figures while contributing three combined steals and blocks without committing a turnover. He was aggressive from beyond the arc, attempting eight three-pointers despite playing just 12 minutes. However, much of his opportunity came in a lopsided defeat, and his limited role makes him difficult to trust outside deeper fantasy formats.

4687718.h: Minott posted 15 points (4-12 FG, 3-10 3Pt, 4-4 FT), eight rebounds, two assists and two steals across 21 minutes during Sunday's 136-109 loss to the Pacers.
4687718.s: Despite coming off the bench, Minott hauled in a team-high eight boards Sunday. The forward likely saw more playing time because Indiana ran away with this contest in the second half, but Minott made a case Sunday to challenge the struggling Noah Clowney for reserve minutes in the frontcourt.

4687718.h: Minott finished Saturday's 125-121 loss to the Cavaliers with four points (2-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and two rebounds in nine minutes.
4687718.s: Minott didn't see the floor in Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Hornets but made his 2026-27 regular-season debut Saturday. The 23-year-old forward signed a two-year, $9 million contract with the club this past offseason but faces an uphill battle for a consistent role.

4687718.h: Minott recorded four points (1-5 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 1-5 FT), three rebounds and one assist in 18 minutes during Thursday's 114-108 preseason victory over Philadelphia.
4687718.s: Minott endured a difficult shooting performance, converting just one field-goal attempt and missing four of his five free throws. The 23-year-old forward also committed two turnovers while seeing time off the bench. Minott will look to bounce back during Brooklyn's remaining preseason contests as he competes for minutes in a crowded forward rotation.

4697268.h: Jones (ankle/two-way player) is out for Friday's game against Toronto.
4697268.s: It's not clear whether Jones is still dealing with a right ankle injury or if he's been ruled out due to his status as a two-way player. He'll presumably open the year with the G League's Wisconsin Herd once he's back at full strength.

4697268.h: Jones (ankle) won't play Wednesday in Boston.
4697268.s: Jones will miss his first game of the season due to injury, and for now, he should be viewed as questionable for Friday's meeting with the Raptors. Jones is not a rotation player for the Bucks.

4697268.h: Jones (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday against the Celtics.
4697268.s: Jones is dealing with a right ankle sprain and was a late addition to the injury report. His status doesn't hold much weight in fantasy hoops, as he's outside of the current rotation.

4697268.h: Jones accumulated 23 points (9-14 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 3-5 FT), four rebounds, one assist and one steal over 22 minutes in Wednesday's 125-104 preseason loss to Chicago.
4697268.s: Jones went scoreless across 17 combined minutes in his first two preseason appearances but made the most of extended playing time Wednesday. The Marquette product was the only player to eclipse the 20-point mark, providing a major scoring boost off the bench. Signed to a two-way deal, Jones is likely to spend much of the regular season with the G League's Wisconsin Herd.

4698719.h: Brazile racked up eight points (3-5 FG, 2-2 3Pt) and one block over 15 minutes during Sunday's 151-145 overtime win over the Bulls.
4698719.s: Brazile has settled into a reserve role after making early-season starts, averaging just 15.2 minutes over his last five appearances. His inconsistent opportunities and limited offensive involvement leave him with minimal fantasy appeal outside deeper leagues.

4698719.h: Brazile totaled five points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT) and three rebounds in 16 minutes during Saturday's 116-108 win over New Orleans.
4698719.s: Brazile offered very little in terms of tangible production, and he has now scored no more than seven points in seven straight games. After a brief moment in the sun to begin the season, Brazile has fallen off the radar in standard leagues, averaging 5.3 points and 4.3 rebounds in six appearances over the past two weeks.

4698719.h: Brazile ended with three points (1-3 FG, 1-2 3Pt), four rebounds and two assists over 14 minutes during Saturday's 114-102 win over the Pacers.
4698719.s: Brazile was mostly a non-factor, playing a season-low 14 minutes and scoring no more than six points for the fourth straight game. After a minor breakout to begin the season, the reality of the NBA has dawned on Brazile. In those four games over the past week, he has been outside the top 200 in standard leagues, averaging 5.0 points, 5.3 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 18.5 minutes per game.

4698719.h: Brazile won't start Friday's game against the Suns.
4698719.s: The rookie got the starting nod in Wednesday's win over the Pelicans, but he'll slide back to the second unit Friday with Cameron Johnson (ankle) back in action. Brazile has averaged 9.0 points, 7.3 rebounds and 0.7 blocks across 21.0 minutes per game in three outings off the bench this season.

4698719.h: Brazile will start Wednesday against the Pelicans.
4698719.s: Brazile will replace Bryce Hopkins in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game, and he'll be joined by Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokic in the first unit. Brazile scored 17 points over 28 minutes in Saturday's 134-114 overtime win over the Pelicans, so it'll be interesting to see what he can do in a starting role in this rematch.

4698719.h: Brazile notched 17 points (6-11 FG, 3-7 3Pt, 2-4 FT), nine rebounds, two blocks and one steal over 28 minutes during Saturday's 141-135 overtime win over the Pelicans.
4698719.s: Brazile fell one rebound short of his first career double-double, playing a key role for Denver down the stretch. He continues to impress with his energy on both ends of the floor and may have just put himself on the radar in standard fantasy leagues. With Cameron Johnson (ankle) set to miss time, it appears as though Brazile is going to be utilized as a sixth-man option. Keeping in mind that he is a rookie, expect…

4698719.h: Brazile contributed four points (1-6 FG, 0-4 3Pt, 2-2 FT) and 12 rebounds over 18 minutes during Thursday's 96-84 loss to the Thunder.
4698719.s: Brazile made an immediate impact on the glass in Denver's season opener, collecting three offensive rebounds and nine defensive boards despite limited playing time. His shooting was inefficient, but the strong rebounding performance could help him earn additional opportunities in the frontcourt rotation.

4701208.h: Cisse will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale versus the Hawks.
4701208.s: Daniel Gafford (rest) is back and starting after sitting out Wednesday's preseason loss to the Pelicans, so Cisse will return to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit this preseason, Cisse is averaging 1.5 points and 3.5 rebounds in 10.5 minutes per game.

4701208.h: Cisse (ankle) is available for Friday's preseason game versus Atlanta.
4701208.s: Cisse is nursing a sprained left ankle, though it won't keep him off the court for the Mavericks' final exhibition. The 24-year-old has averaged 3.7 points, 4.3 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.0 steals and 1.3 blocks across 12.5 minutes per outing in three preseason appearances.

4701208.h: Head coach Dusty May said Cisse (ankle) didn't practice Thursday as a precaution but added that the big man "would've been able to play" if there was a game, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4701208.s: Cisse sprained his left ankle in Wednesday's loss to the Pelicans and could sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks as a precautionary measure. Even if he doesn't play Friday, it appears Cisse is trending toward being available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Houston.

4701208.h: Cisse exited Wednesday's 101-97 preseason loss to New Orleans due to a left ankle sprain.
4701208.s: Cisse exited early, though Dallas head coach Dusty May downplayed the severity of the injury. "They said he tweaked an ankle and I don't think preseason is a reason to push it," May said, per Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News. As such, the Mavericks could opt to hold Cisse out of Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta.

4701208.h: Cisse will start in Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
4701208.s: Cisse will make his first start of the preseason. The 24-year-old hasn't had a productive preseason thus far, averaging 1.5 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.0 steals over 10.5 minutes per contest in two appearances.

4701208.h: Cisse amassed zero points (0-3 FG), six rebounds, three assists and two steals in 14 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason loss to Houston.
4701208.s: Cisse served as the third-string center, playing behind Morez Johnson and Daniel Gafford. Despite a few bright spots last season, it appears as though Cisse could struggle to have a consistent presence in the rotation, particularly if Dereck Lively returns from his foot injury at any point. Nevertheless, Cisse is someone to monitor just in case injuries befall the Dallas frontcourt, especially for those needing…

4701225.h: Hall (ankle) registered four points (1-3 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT) and three rebounds over eight minutes in Tuesday's 124-90 preseason loss to the Nets.
4701225.s: Hall had his 2025-26 campaign cut short after he fractured his ankle, but he's back and ready to go for the upcoming season. In 12 games with the Hornets last year, Hall averaged 6.1 points and 5.5 rebounds per game.

4701230.h: Johnson closed with 12 points (4-10 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), 11 rebounds and one steal across 30 minutes during Sunday's 107-97 victory over the Pistons.
4701230.s: Johnson has averaged 19.0 points, 10.2 rebounds, 6.4 assists and 35.0 minutes over his last five games. Despite Sunday's scoreless assist column, his playmaking remains elite for a forward, though inconsistent perimeter shooting has limited his scoring efficiency.

4701230.h: Johnson tallied 26 points (10-15 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 3-4 FT), six rebounds, six assists, four steals and one block across 36 minutes during Friday's 111-97 win over Charlotte.
4701230.s: Johnson delivered a stellar performance to help Atlanta win a third consecutive game. He led all players in scoring while racking up five defensive stats, the latter of which equals his total in that category over the last five contests. Johnson was highly efficient from everywhere Friday, an especially positive note after he went a combined 10-for-28 (35.7 percent) in his previous two outings.

4701230.h: Johnson racked up 16 points (5-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 5-5 FT), 12 rebounds, 11 assists and one block over 34 minutes in Wednesday's 117-112 win over the Thunder.
4701230.s: This was Johnson's second triple-double of the season and the 17th of his career. However, he continued to struggle with his three-point shot, and he's opened the 2026-27 season converting just 18.0 percent of his long balls. Before this season, he was a career 33.5 percent three-point shooter, so it should only be a matter of time until he finds his footing from long-range.

4701230.h: Johnson logged 14 points (5-13 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 4-8 FT), 11 rebounds and five assists in 35 minutes during Sunday's 113-106 victory over the Bucks.
4701230.s: After delivering his first triple-double of the season Friday against the Bulls, Johnson followed it up with his fifth double-double Sunday. The 24-year-old forward has looked good in four contests since returning from a sprained ankle, averaging 21.5 points, 9.0 boards, 6.3 assists and 1.0 steals in 37.3 minutes.

4701230.h: ATL: McCollum, NAW, Daniels, Johnson, Okongwu
4701230.s: CJ McCollum, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Dyson Daniels, Jalen Johnson and Onyeka Okongwu will start Sunday's game against the Bucks.

4701230.h: Johnson produced 27 points (11-26 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 11 rebounds, 10 assists and one steal across 40 minutes in Friday's 125-117 overtime loss to the Bulls.
4701230.s: Johnson didn't deliver his most efficient performance, though he did lead the Hawks in points, rebounds and assists en route to his first triple-double of the season. The star forward has reached the 20-point threshold in two of his last three games, though he's missed all 11 of his three-point attempts during that stretch. Through 10 regular-season games, Johnson has posted a triple-double and three double-doubles.

4701230.h: Johnson recorded 30 points (11-17 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 8-10 FT), seven rebounds, six assists and one steal in 36 minutes during Saturday's 124-121 win over Brooklyn.
4701230.s: Johnson returned to action after missing the previous three games due to an ankle injury. He showed no signs of rust, leading all scorers with 30 points, powering Atlanta to a come-from-behind victory. It appears to be all systems go for Johnson, especially given he played 36 minutes in his return. Barring any setbacks, expect to see him leading from the front again when the Lakers come to town Monday.

4701230.h: Johnson (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.
4701230.s: Johnson has missed each of Atlanta's last three games due to a sprained left ankle, though it seems likely that his string of absences will end Saturday. The 24-year-old has gotten off to another strong start this season, averaging 18.3 points, 9.0 rebounds and 7.9 assists in 32.6 minutes per game.

4701230.h: Johnson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Wizards.
4701230.s: This will be Johnson's third straight game on the sidelines, and for now, he should be considered questionable for Saturday's meeting with the Nets. Luguentz Dort should continue to start in his absence, while Nickeil Alexander-Walker and Onyeka Okongwu will see a larger role on offense.

4701232.h: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4701232.s: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With Williams on the inactive list, Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach figure to see increased playing time, with the latter already drawing buzz during Summer League play. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks, and while nothing official has come from the Suns, Phoenix radio host John Gambadoro reports that…

4701233.h: Porter accumulated two points (1-2 FG), three assists, two steals and one rebound in 14 minutes during Monday's 126-115 win over Chicago.
4701233.s: With Evan Mobley (toe), Jaylon Tyson (ankle) and Sam Merrill (elbow) sidelined, Porter saw double-digit minutes for a second straight game. The 26-year-old didn't offer much in the scoring column, though he recorded a season-high two steals while chipping in three assists. Over eight appearances this month, he's averaged 2.5 points, 2.5 rebounds and 2.3 assists in 13.5 minutes per showing.

4701233.h: Porter finished Thursday's 114-106 loss to the 76ers with zero points (0-1 FG), three rebounds and one steal in seven minutes.
4701233.s: Porter saw minimal playing time in Cleveland's season opener, attempting just one shot while operating near the end of the rotation. With James Harden and Donovan Mitchell handling the bulk of the backcourt responsibilities, Porter faces an uphill battle for consistent minutes and fantasy relevance.

4701233.h: Porter recorded five points (2-3 FG, 1-2 3Pt), three rebounds, 10 assists, two steals and one block in 16 minutes during Thursday's 124-113 preseason loss to Boston.
4701233.s: Porter delivered an impressive playmaking performance, reaching double-digit assists without committing a turnover. His ability to facilitate the offense and contribute defensively could strengthen his case for backcourt minutes, although Cleveland's guard depth may make consistent playing time difficult to secure.

4701233.h: Porter is lined up as Cleveland's top backup point guard after the franchise re-signed James Harden.
4701233.s: Porter did benefit from the departure of Dennis Schroder, who previously served as the team's No. 2 point guard following last year's trade deadline. Tre Mann, who was originally acquired for Schroder, has since been rerouted to Washington, so Porter seems to have only Tyrese Proctor to beat out for the role during training camp.

4702134.h: Omier has agreed to a two-way contract with the Timberwolves, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4702134.s: Omier averaged 18.3 points on 59.2 percent shooting, 11.4 rebounds and 2.5 assists per game in the G League last season. The 25-year-old forward brings an impressive rebounding profile to Minnesota, though he'll likely spend much of his time developing in the G League. Omier is unlikely to have a significant fantasy impact unless injuries open up opportunities in the Timberwolves' frontcourt.

4702134.h: Omier was waived by the Timberwolves on Saturday.
4702134.s: Omier appeared in six regular-season games for the Clippers in 2025-26, averaging 2.8 points and 1.2 rebounds over 3.9 minutes per contest. After a quiet preseason, the 25-year-old will once again be on the hunt for a spot on an NBA roster, though it's possible he will find work in the G League.

4702134.h: Omier signed a training camp contract with the Timberwolves on Friday, Paul Garcia of The Spot Up Shot reports.
4702134.s: Omier spent part of the 2025-26 season on a two-way deal with the Clippers and is now set to compete for a spot on Minnesota's regular-season roster. The 25-year-old appeared in 38 G League games between the San Diego Clippers and Cleveland Charge last season, averaging 18.3 points, 11.5 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 29.3 minutes per contest.

4702177.h: Ellis produced eight points (3-5 FG, 2-3 3Pt), two rebounds, two blocks and one steal in 20 minutes during Monday's 135-123 loss to the 76ers.
4702177.s: Ellis was efficient from the field and tied for the game-high mark in blocks against Philadelphia. He saw just seven minutes of action in Saturday's loss to Memphis, though he returned to a meaningful role Monday and logged 20-plus minutes of action for the third time over his last four appearances. During that span, he's averaged 5.5 points, 2.0 assists, 1.8 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 18.8 minutes per tilt.

4702177.h: Ellis notched one point (0-1 FG, 1-2 FT), two rebounds and one steal across 10 minutes during Wednesday's 114-104 win over the Hornets.
4702177.s: After starting the first three games of the season, Ellis has since come off the bench in five straight games, culminating in a 10-minute performance Wednesday. It appears as though Brooklyn is already leaning into its youth, meaning Eliis' time as a standard-league fantasy asset may have come and gone.

4702177.h: Ellis will come off the bench in Tuesday's meeting with the Celtics, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
4702177.s: The Nets have gone 0-3 to start the season, so head coach Jodi Fernandez will shuffle his starting lineup, sending Ellis to the second unit. As a reserve last season, Ellis averaged 6.0 points and 1.1 steals in 19.3 minutes per game.

4702177.h: Ellis registered nine points (4-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt), one rebound, three assists, one block and four steals in 23 minutes during Sunday's 136-109 loss to Indiana.
4702177.s: Ellis continues to make a big impact on the defensive end of the floor, having picked up multiple steals in three straight games to open the season. The expectation is that rookie first-rounder Mikel Brown is eventually going to overtake Ellis for a starting spot in the backcourt once Brown's restrictions are lifted, but Ellis should continue to deliver low-end fantasy numbers until that change is implemented.

4702177.h: Ellis accumulated seven points (3-7 FG, 1-3 3Pt), two rebounds, four assists, one block and two steals across 34 minutes during Wednesday's 110-103 loss to the Hornets.
4702177.s: With Brooklyn opting to ease rookie first-rounder Mikel Brown into the NBA fray, Ellis is operating as the team's starting shooting guard in the interim. Given Wednesday's workload, Ellis is worth keeping tabs on in fantasy leagues for his ability to supply treys and steals when given significant minutes.

4702177.h: Ellis finished with 15 points (4-7 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 4-5 FT) and a rebound across 21 minutes in Monday's 131-122 preseason win over the Wizards.
4702177.s: Ellis delivered an efficient offensive performance, connecting on three of his four attempts from beyond the arc and profiling as one of four Brooklyn players who scored at least 15 points. He didn't record an assist, steal or block, making this a relatively scoring-dependent fantasy showing. However, his perimeter shooting helped Brooklyn maintain its offensive momentum, and he committed no turnovers during his…

4702177.h: Eliis finished with just five points (2-3 FG, 1-2 3Pt) in 12 minutes during Tuesday's 124-90 preseason victory over Charlotte.
4702177.s: With projected starter Mikel Brown sidelined due to a minor ankle injury, Ellis was inserted into the starting lineup. Despite the opportunity, Ellis failed to produce much of note, particularly on the defensive end of the floor. Assuming Brown gets back on the court in the near future, Ellis will likely shift back to a bench role to begin the season. At best, he should be considered a late-round flyer in fantasy…

4702177.h: Ellis is starting Tuesday's preseason opener against the Hornets, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
4702177.s: The veteran swingman is getting the nod in the absence of rookie Mikel Brown (ankle) on Tuesday. Ellis could be ticketed for a bench role once Brooklyn is healthy, though.

4702352.h: Sanders provided five points (2-6 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 1-1 FT), one rebound, three assists and two steals across 18 minutes during Tuesday's 132-107 loss to the Jazz.
4702352.s: Sanders has scored five or fewer points in three consecutive appearances, averaging just 4.0 points while shooting 5-for-11 from the field during that stretch. The second-year wing has averaged 17.7 minutes over those contests after logging at least 22 minutes in three of his previous four games. Despite contributing occasional assists and steals, his declining offensive production and limited playing time restrict…

4702352.h: Sanders produced nine points (2-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 4-4 FT), three rebounds, seven assists and one steal over 26 minutes during Tuesday's 133-110 loss to the Suns.
4702352.s: Sanders led the Clippers with seven assists off the bench and played a team-high 26 minutes. With the game out of reach early, the second unit saw extended run, which inflated Sanders' playing time. While he is a capable secondary playmaker, he is unlikely to see this kind of workload in more competitive contests. For now, he should be viewed as a deep-league option only.

4702352.h: Sanders will come off the bench in Wednesday's game versus Miami, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4702352.s: Derrick Jones (knee) is back and starting after a one-game stint on the sidelines, so Sanders will return to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit this season, Sanders is averaging 8.4 points, 2.4 assists, 1.6 triples and 1.2 steals per contest.

4702352.h: Sanders registered 26 points (8-17 FG, 5-11 3Pt, 5-5 FT), four rebounds, three assists and one block in 38 minutes during Monday's 125-118 loss to Toronto.
4702352.s: Sanders took full advantage of a spot start Monday and filled in admirably for Rui Hachimura (quadriceps). The 24-year-old Sanders led the Clippers in the scoring department with the help of a team-high five triples, which is also his best mark of the young season. He's now 9-for-17 from deep over his last two matchups.

4702352.h: Sanders is in the starting lineup for Monday's game against the Raptors, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
4702352.s: Rui Hachimura (quadriceps) is sitting out Monday, which opens up a spot in the starting five for Sanders. This marks the 24-year-old's second start of the new campaign. He finished with nine points, four rebounds and three steals in 27 minutes in his first start of the year Wednesday against the Lakers.

4702352.h: Sanders totaled 16 points (6-9 FG, 4-6 3Pt), three rebounds and one steal in 30 minutes off the bench during Sunday's 124-112 loss to the Warriors.
4702352.s: The four made threes were a career high for Sanders, while the 16 points were a season high. The second-year forward has scored in double digits just twice in six games (one start) to begin the season, averaging 8.5 points, 3.0 boards, 2.0 assists, 1.5 steals and 1.5 threes in 23.2 minutes, but his role and usage figure to increase while Max Strus (foot) and Derrick Jones (knee) are on the shelf.

4702352.h: Sanders isn't starting Friday against the Timberwolves, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4702352.s: Sanders will return to his regular bench role with Rui Hachimura (calf) back in the starting five. Sanders is averaging 6.3 points and 2.3 rebounds per game in three appearances off the bench this season.

4702352.h: Sanders will be in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game versus the Lakers, per Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com.
4702352.s: Rui Hachimura is dealing with a calf issue, and the Clippers are planning for Sanders to make his first start of the season in his place. Last regular season, Sanders averaged 10.6 points, 2.6 rebounds and 1.8 assists in 27.3 minutes per contest covering 16 games as a starter.

4702352.h: Sanders finished with 12 points (4-10 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 2-2 FT), four rebounds, two assists and one steal in 20 minutes during Sunday's 108-101 loss to the Thunder.
4702352.s: Sanders was one of three Clippers to tally double figures in scoring off the bench in what was his most productive game so far in 2026-27. With Rui Hachimura struggling with his shot early in the season (26.3/31.6/55.6 shooting splits), Sanders could earn more opportunities going forward.

4997538.s: Matkovic has averaged just 2.2 points, 2.6 rebounds and 13.2 minutes over his last five appearances. With Yves Missi and Derik Queen also competing for frontcourt minutes, Matkovic's limited offensive involvement and inconsistent workload restrict his fantasy appeal.

4997538.h: Matkovic won't start Friday's game against Memphis, Rod Walker of The Times-Picayune reports.
4997538.s: Matkovic started New Orleans' last eight games, though DeAndre Jordan will move into the starting five Friday. Matkovic has averaged 5.0 points and 2.3 rebounds in 11.7 minutes per game across three outings off the bench this season.

4997538.h: Matkovic had 18 points (7-13 FG, 4-8 3Pt), three rebounds and one assist across 18 minutes during Friday's 115-109 loss to the Timberwolves.
4997538.s: Making his fifth straight start in place of Yves Missi (knee), Matkovic was mainly used as a stretch big, with his three boards being his lowest mark so far during his stint in the starting five. The third-year center is averaging 13.6 points, 5.4 rebounds, 2.6 threes, 1.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 0.8 blocks over 22.8 minutes in his new role while shooting 62.5 percent from the floor and a sizzling 56.5 percent…

4997538.h: Matkovic finished Monday's 135-134 overtime win over the Grizzlies with 25 points (9-13 FG, 5-8 3Pt, 2-4 FT), six rebounds, one assist, one block and two steals over 29 minutes.
4997538.s: Matkovic delivered his best performance of the season, helping New Orleans to an impressive win over the previously undefeated Memphis. That makes three consecutive starts for Matkovic, during which time he has averaged 15.0 points, 6.7 rebounds, 2.7 three-pointers and 3.0 combined steals and blocks. It appears as though he has secured himself the starting center spot, at least until Yves Missi returns from a knee…

4997538.h: Matkovic closed Saturday's 121-99 victory over Atlanta with eight points (3-4 FG, 2-2 3Pt), 10 rebounds, one assist, one block and one steal across 18 minutes.
4997538.s: In his second start of the 2026-27 campaign, Matkovic led the Pelicans with a season-high 10 rebounds and was two points shy from recording his first double-double since March 16 against the Mavericks. Yves Missi is recovering from a bone bruise in his left knee and is considered week-to-week, so Matkovic figures to remain in New Orleans' starting lineup for as long as the former is out of action.

4997538.h: Matkovic is in the starting lineup for Thursday's game against the Kings.
4997538.s: Matkovic will make his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. DeAndre Jordan has drawn starts at center in each of the Pelicans' last two games for the injured Yves Missi (knee), but it'll be Matkovic who gets a look Thursday. He's had a limited impact off the bench through three games, averaging 5.0 points and 2.3 rebounds in 11.7 minutes.

4997538.h: Matkovic is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Wizards.
4997538.s: Matkovic started in Wednesday's 101-97 preseason victory over the Mavericks. However, he will return to the bench for the Pelicans' final exhibition before they face the Pacers on Opening Night.

4997538.h: Matkovic contributed 11 points (3-4 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 2-2 FT) and two rebounds across 18 minutes in Wednesday's 101-97 preseason win over Dallas.
4997538.s: Matkovic made his first start of the preseason after coming off the bench in the first two contests. The 25-year-old did most of his scoring from the field beyond the arc, knocking down a team-high three triples in a winning effort. Across 62 regular-season appearances (two starts) in 2025-26, Matkovic averaged 5.7 points and 3.7 rebounds in 14.7 minutes per contest.

4997538.h: Matkovic finished with nine points (4-7 FG, 1-3 3Pt) and three rebounds in 12 minutes during Thursday's 128-118 preseason loss to Miami.
4997538.s: Matkovic was productive offensively in limited playing time, converting four of his seven field-goal attempts while adding a three-pointer. The big man faces competition for frontcourt minutes from Yves Missi and Derik Queen, leaving his regular-season role uncertain despite the encouraging preseason showing.

4997538.h: Matkovic recorded 17 points (8-8 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 0-1 FT), one assist and two turnovers in 17 minutes during Croatia's 115-80 win over Latvia in Thursday's FIBA World Cup qualifier.
4997538.s: The 25-year-old showed encouraging progress with New Orleans last season and enters 2026-27 as part of a crowded frontcourt that also includes Derik Queen and Yves Missi. Matkovic's ability to protect the rim while stretching the floor gives him a different skill set than the Pelicans' other young big men, but the competition for minutes could make his role volatile. He'll be a player to monitor during training…

5023693.h: Proctor will come off the bench in Monday's matchup with the Bulls, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5023693.s: Sam Merrill will replace Proctor in the first unit for Monday's game. As a reserve this season, Proctor is averaging 7.8 points, 2.5 assists and 1.5 triples per contest.

Although he has now started in four straight games, it's clear that his opportunities are beginning to shrink. 5023693.h: Proctor had 17 points (6-13 FG, 2-6 3Pt, 3-5 FT), three rebounds, two assists, two steals and one block over 29 minutes during Monday's 126-115 victory over the Bulls.
5023693.s: After dropping a triple-double in Saturday's win over Dallas, Proctor remained in the starting five Monday in the absences of Evan Mobley (toe) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle). 5023693.h: CLE: Harden, Mitchell, Proctor, Watson, Allen

5023693.s: Tyrese Proctor recorded a triple-double with a team-high 24 points (10-of-19 FGs), 11 rebounds and 10 assists to lead the Cavaliers to a 127-117 win over the Mavericks on Saturday.

5023693.h: Proctor posted 24 points (10-19 FG, 4-13 3Pt), 11 rebounds and 10 assists across 34 minutes during Saturday's 127-117 win over Dallas.
5023693.s: Proctor earned his second start of the season and more than delivered for a short-handed Cavs team, as the 2025 second-round pick recorded the first triple-double of his career. Prior to…

5023693.h: Proctor will start in Saturday's game versus the Mavericks.
5023693.s: The Cavaliers' starters won't suit up for this contest, so Proctor will enter the starting lineup Saturday for the second time this season. 5023693.h: Proctor recorded 22 points (7-9 FG, 5-7 3Pt, 3-4 FT), four rebounds, three assists and one steal across 27 minutes during Friday's 133-121 loss to the Heat.
5023693.s: Proctor made the most of his minutes and matched his previous career-high mark in scoring, but five three-pointers on seven attempts isn't a realistic nightly expectation. The more encouraging development is that Cleveland trusted him with a heavy workload, even with Donovan Mitchell and James Harden available. Proctor's role remains relatively modest behind Cleveland's established guards, making consistent fantasy…

5023693.h: Proctor provided 15 points (6-12 FG, 3-8 3Pt), three rebounds and one assist over 23 minutes in Wednesday's 115-107 win over the Knicks.
5023693.s: Proctor gave the Cavaliers a nice lift off the bench, scoring a season-high 15 points Wednesday. The second-year guard has logged at least 18 minutes in seven consecutive games, but it remains to be seen if Proctor hangs onto a similar role once Sam Merrill (elbow) returns.

5037871.h: Harper (hip) is expected to miss two to three weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037871.s: Harper has been diagnosed with a left hip external rotator strain, and San Antonio is now set to be without one of its regular guards for an extended stretch. His absence creates more backcourt minutes for the Spurs, likely most prominently for Justin Champagnie while the team waits for Tobias Harris (calf) to make his season debut. De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle should see extra ball-handling duties as well.

If there are no setbacks, the second-year guard could be an option for Saturday's game against the Pelicans. Julian Champagnie is likely to start in Harper's place in the meantime.

5037871.h: Harper (hip) won't play in Thursday's game against the Clippers, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

He tallied 20 points (8-14 FG, 0-4 3Pt, 4-5 FT), four rebounds and two assists in 35 minutes prior to his exit, and we'll have to wait for an update on his status moving forward.

5037871.h: Dylan Harper goes off for career-high 31 points

5037871.s: Harper played an efficient game, adding nine points and four assists without a turnover. Friday's blowout limited everyone's minutes, but his poise as a starter has been one of the quieter positives of San Antonio's hot start.

5037873.h: Powell was recalled by the Nets on Thursday, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037873.s: Powell has appeared in five games with Brooklyn this season, averaging 2.0 points and 1.2 assists in 7.2 minutes per game. He's not expected to play a big role in the rotation.

5037873.h: Powell has been assigned to the Nets' G League affiliate and won't play Wednesday against the Hornets, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037873.s: Powell has been out of the rotation the past two games for Brooklyn, so he'll head down to the G League to stay fresh. His next chance to play will come Saturday in Atlanta.

5037873.h: Brooklyn recalled Powell from the G League's Long Island Nets on Friday.
5037873.s: Assuming he stays with the club for the day, Powell will be available to face the Pistons on Friday. He will remain an emergency depth option for the club going forward.

5037873.s: Powell remains part of Brooklyn's long-term plans as the organization continues developing its young talent. The second-year wing will have additional time to establish himself at the NBA level, though the contract decision doesn't guarantee a larger rotation role. His fantasy value remains limited without consistent playing time.

5037873.h: The Nets assigned Powell to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
5037873.s: Powell will continue his development with Long Island after struggling to carve out a consistent role in Brooklyn's rotation. The second-year wing could return to the NBA roster as needed, but he isn't currently positioned to provide meaningful fantasy production.

5037873.h: Powell (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
5037873.s: The second-year wing was excluded from Brooklyn's rotation to begin the campaign. Powell faces competition for perimeter minutes and will need to capitalize on future opportunities to establish a larger role.

5037873.s: Powell didn't commit a turnover and made the most of his limited opportunities, connecting on four of his six attempts from the field. The young wing will look to use the preseason to strengthen his case for a spot in Brooklyn's rotation after a tough 2025-26 campaign.

5041935.h: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5041935.s: The rookie standout has been diagnosed with a moderate-grade ankle sprain, and he'll be sidelined for at least the next month or so. It's a tough blow for an upstart Grizzlies team, which will now rely even more heavily on Ty Jerome's playmaking for the foreseeable future. Taylor Hendricks has a chance to nail down a consistent role off the bench as well.

5041935.h: Cameron Boozer (right ankle sprain) to be reevaluated in four weeks, Grizzlies announce
Boozer (ankle) won't play in Monday's game against the Hornets.
5041935.s: Boozer will miss a second straight outing due to a sprained right ankle. 5041935.h: Cameron Boozer (ankle) remains out Monday vs. CHA
5041935.s: Cameron Boozer (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Hornets.

5041935.h: Boozer is out for Saturday's game against Minnesota due to a right ankle sprain.
5041935.s: The rookie sensation is sitting out for the first time this season and can be deemed day-to-day for the time being. His absence will open up plenty of usage for Ty Jerome (hip), who's set to return from a three-game layoff, and likely opens up a spot in the starting lineup for Isaiah Stewart.

5041935.h: Boozer amassed 16 points (6-6 FG, 4-4 FT), six rebounds, five assists and one block across 27 minutes during Thursday's 126-98 victory over the Warriors.
5041935.s: Boozer didn't miss a shot Thursday, showcasing his efficiency without needing heavy offensive volume. The rookie has recorded at least five assists in four straight games, highlighting his growing playmaking role. His ability to contribute across multiple categories provides a strong fantasy foundation even when his scoring fluctuates.

5041935.h: Boozer accumulated 18 points (5-9 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 7-7 FT), eight rebounds, five assists, one block and four steals over 28 minutes during Wednesday's 124-121 win over the Cavaliers.
5041935.s: Boozer ripped away a career-high four steals as he helped the Grizzlies earn their fourth straight win. Memphis remains undefeated away from home, and it is the first team to open the season 8-0 on the road since the 2020-21 Lakers.

5041935.h: Boozer supplied 29 points (10-21 FG, 7-13 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds, seven assists and one block across 29 minutes in Monday's 136-120 win over Washington.
5041935.s: Boozer turned in an excellent all-around effort, highlighted by a game-high and career-high point total. The rookie has eclipsed the 20-point mark four times through 14 appearances this season. Across the board, he's impressed with averages of 16.5 points, 9.5 rebounds and 5.4 assists in 31.3 minutes per tilt while starting every game.

5041935.h: Boozer finished with 15 points (7-13 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 1-3 FT), eight rebounds, five assists, two steals and two blocks across 29 minutes in Saturday's 129-110 win over the Nets.
5041935.s: Boozer recorded his fourth consecutive double-digit scoring performance to lead Memphis to its third win in the last four games. The rookie has played well in his first 13 regular-season games, averaging 15.5 points, 9.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists across 31.5 minutes per contest. However, Boozer hasn't shot the ball well, draining just 28.4 percent of his attempts from behind the arc.

5041935.h: Cam Spencer starting in place of Ty Jerome

5041939.s: Flagg delivered his best offensive showing of the 2026-27 season so far, beating his previous high of 33 points Oct. 30 against Houston. 5041951.s: Thomas drew a start Saturday against Dallas and took advantage of the chance, finishing with 20 points, three triples, four rebounds and two assists in 34 minutes. However, he'll return to a bench role now that Peyton Watson, Donovan Mitchell and James Harden are back in action.

5041955.s: Peterson's scoring has cooled considerably after four consecutive 20-point performances earlier this month. He's averaged 13.4 points in 28.2 minutes over his last five games, but Lauri Markkanen's (hand) absence should continue providing opportunities for the rookie.

5041955.h: Peterson ended Wednesday's 109-97 win over the Lakers with 11 points (3-5 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 4-6 FT), one rebound and three assists over 19 minutes.

5041955.h: Peterson logged 13 points (3-10 FG, 2-4 3Pt, 5-7 FT), five rebounds, two assists and one steal in 31 minutes during Tuesday's 132-107 victory over the Clippers.
5041955.s: Peterson never found his shooting touch, but he still finished with a decent total as the Jazz snapped their long losing streak. The No. 2 overall pick has been one of the few bright spots in a rough start for the club, averaging 17.1 points as a rookie. With Lauri Markkanen (hand) and Jaren Jackson (knee) sidelined, Peterson should continue to get a heavy share of the offense.

5041955.h: Peterson recorded 17 points (7-20 FG, 3-9 3Pt), five rebounds, four assists, one block and one steal over 34 minutes during Sunday's 110-102 loss to San Antonio.
5041955.s: Peterson didn't deliver his most efficient shooting performance in Sunday's loss. However, the rookie guard still finished as Utah's second-leading scorer while chipping in multiple combined steals-plus-blocks for a third straight game. He's scored at least 17 points in six straight games, during which he's averaged 23.2 points, 4.7 rebounds, 4.0 assists, 1.3 steals and 1.0 blocks in 32.8 minutes per showing.

5041955.h: Peterson finished with 28 points (9-20 FG, 4-11 3Pt, 6-7 FT), seven rebounds, two assists, two steals and one block across 34 minutes in Friday's 125-118 loss to the Rockets.
5041955.s: Peterson led Utah in scoring while knocking down four triples and contributing across multiple categories. The rookie guard attempted a team-high 20 shots, highlighting his prominent offensive role despite the defeat. Although his efficiency from beyond the arc left room for improvement, Peterson's combination of scoring volume, rebounding and defensive production makes him an intriguing fantasy option as he…

5041955.h: Peterson finished with 22 points (7-19 FG, 2-9 3Pt, 6-6 FT), four rebounds, five assists, one steal and one block over 33 minutes in Wednesday's 123-108 loss to the Magic.
5041955.s: This was Peterson's fourth straight 20-plus-point performance, and he again led his team in shot attempts. With Lauri Markkanen (hand) set to miss at least the next month, there's a massive hole to fill in Utah's offense, but Peterson looks ready to step into a larger role offensively.

5041955.h: Peterson fouled out of Tuesday's 115-109 loss to the Heat after recording 25 points (10-19 FG, 4-9 3Pt, 1-2 FT), four rebounds, four assists and one steal over 31 minutes.
5041955.s: Peterson came close to posting a new career high yet again after scoring his season-high 26 Tuesday, and the rookie is starting to look comfortable as Utah's go-to scorer. The turnovers and fouls are still part of the learning curve, but with three starters out, the Jazz are giving him all the touches he can handle. Utah hosts Orlando on Wednesday to finish a back-to-back.

5041955.h: Peterson delivered 26 points (11-21 FG, 4-8 3Pt), six rebounds, four assists and a steal across 35 minutes in Sunday's 115-100 loss to the Timberwolves.
5041955.s: Peterson carried a substantial offensive workload, attempting a team-high 21 shots, and he seems to be finding his footing offensively while scoring at least 20 points in back-to-back games for the first time in his career. The rookie's current playing time and newfound prominent scoring role remain encouraging indicators for his fantasy outlook. He's also surpassed the 15-point mark in four of his last six outings,…

5044385.h: Miller logged four points (1-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-4 FT), six rebounds, three assists and one block in 19 minutes during Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks.
5044385.s: Miller made the most of his limited offensive opportunities, collecting three offensive rebounds while contributing as a passer and rim protector. The reserve forward finished with a plus-six rating despite Chicago's 30-point defeat. His ability to contribute in multiple categories is encouraging, but his modest playing time and limited scoring opportunities restrict his fantasy appeal.

5044385.h: Miller provided nine points (4-7 FG, 1-3 3Pt) and nine rebounds across 14 minutes during Monday's 134-99 loss to Boston.
5044385.s: Miller made the most of his limited playing time, leading Chicago in rebounds despite logging just 14 minutes. The forward collected three offensive boards and narrowly missed his first double-double of the season. Miller has shown flashes of productive play early in the campaign, but his fluctuating minutes could make him difficult to trust in standard fantasy formats.

5044385.h: Miller had 19 points (7-11 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 3-3 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one block across 24 minutes during Friday's 132-125 victory over the Bucks.
5044385.s: Miller turned in another strong performance, playing a larger role than what might have been expected coming into the season. After an encouraging end to the 2025-26 campaign, Miller has picked up where he left off, forcing his way into the rotation. It appears as though head coach Tiago Splitter is not afraid to shuffle his lineups, which is both good and bad when it comes to projecting Miller's fantasy value. At…

5044385.h: Miller (groin) is available for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Toronto.
5044385.s: Miller made some noise in December last season, averaging 16.1 points, 7.9 rebounds, 1.6 triples and 0.9 blocks per contest on 58/41/67 shooting splits through the final seven games of the year. It'll be interesting to see what his role looks like in the rotation while Nic Claxton (hamstring) is out.

5044385.h: Miller is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors with a right adductor strain.
5044385.s: This is a new injury for Miller, though it sounds minor. The Bulls have quite a few injuries, so Miller could be in the mix for a rotation spot after a strong showing in the preseason.

5044385.h: Miller poured in 18 points (7-11 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 1-1 FT), seven rebounds, two steals and one assist across 19 minutes in Wednesday's 125-104 preseason win over Milwaukee.
5044385.s: Miller provided a major boost off the bench for Chicago, trailing only Matas Buzelis (19) in scoring and matching Jalen Smith for the team lead with seven rebounds. Miller has scored in double figures on efficient shooting in all four preseason games, making a compelling case for a meaningful role during the regular season.

5044385.h: Miller logged 26 points (11-14 FG, 4-6 3Pt), seven rebounds and two assists in 22 minutes during Sunday's 133-128 preseason loss to the Nuggets.
5044385.s: Miller put together an impressive performance off the bench Sunday, connecting on four three-pointers en route to a game-high 26 points. The 22-year-old pro has played well throughout the preseason, averaging 17.3 points, 6.3 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.0 steals in 19.7 minutes per contest across three appearances. Miller began to come on at the end of the 2025-26 season, scoring in double figures in 17 of the…

5044385.h: Miller logged 12 points (5-11 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-3 FT), 11 rebounds, two assists and one steal over 23 minutes during Friday's 104-100 preseason loss to Memphis.
5044385.s: It was another strong preseason performance out of Miller, who was close to recording a double-double in the first half alone (eight points and eight rebounds). Even with a strong preseason to solidify his spot on the 15-man roster, Miller faces an uphill battle to playing time, as he figures to operate behind the likes of Patrick Williams, rookie Dailyn Swain, Jalen Smith (foot) and Zach Collins (toe).

5044385.h: Miller finished with 14 points (5-7 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 3-3 FT), one rebound, two assists and two steals in 14 minutes during Wednesday's 124-117 preseason win over Phoenix.
5044385.s: Miller delivered an efficient offensive performance off the bench while adding two steals and committing no turnovers. The 22-year-old forward will look to build on the encouraging showing as he competes for minutes in Chicago's frontcourt, although his regular-season role remains uncertain.

5060631.h: Thiero totaled zero points (0-2 FG, 0-1 3Pt), one assist and one steal over six minutes during Tuesday's 118-114 overtime win over the Hornets.
5060631.s: Thiero continues to see inconsistent playing time in the Lakers' rotation, limiting his opportunities to make an offensive impact. 5060631.s: Thiero missed the first nine games of the season due to a knee injury, and he's now dealing with a sprained left ankle. If he's unable to suit up, Ziaire Williams and Sandro Mamukelashvili will likely soak up any vacated minutes.

5060631.s: Thiero will be available to make his 2026-27 debut after putting a left knee injury behind him. He's not expected to have a role in the rotation early in the campaign.

5060631.s: Thiero is practicing with the G League club amid his knee recovery. He appears to be close to being cleared for his season debut with the Lakers.

5060631.s: Thiero has yet to make his season debut while recovering from a left knee injury, though he's trending in the right direction. However, the second-year forward isn't expected to play a meaningful role once healthy.

5060631.s: Thiero has yet to appear in a regular-season game due to a left knee injury that he picked up during preseason action in early October. His next chance to play is Sunday against the Raptors, but it's unclear when the second-year pro will be cleared to make his 2026-27 debut.

5060701.h: Anderson totaled 15 points (5-9 FG, 3-7 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound, four assists and one steal across 28 minutes during Wednesday's 107-105 loss to the Bulls.
5060701.s: The rookie has scored in double figures in three of his last five appearances, including a career-high 25 points Monday. His growing confidence from beyond the arc and expanding minutes are encouraging, though Charlotte's crowded backcourt could limit his consistency.

The rookie first-round pick also recorded a team-best plus-13 rating in his 25 minutes off the bench. Anderson has now scored 13 or more points in three of his last five outings, as he continues to prove to Charlotte's coaching staff he's deserving of more…

5060701.h: Anderson accumulated five points (2-7 FG, 1-5 3Pt), one rebound, four assists and one steal across 14 minutes during Tuesday's 118-114 overtime loss to the Lakers.
5060701.s: Anderson cooled off offensively after scoring in double figures in consecutive appearances, but his four assists matched his second-highest total of the season. The rookie guard has connected on multiple three-pointers in three of his last four games, showing encouraging perimeter shooting despite inconsistent playing time. His limited role in Charlotte's backcourt keeps him primarily a deep-league fantasy option.

5060701.h: Anderson totaled 16 points (5-10 FG, 4-8 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds, two assists and two steals across 18 minutes during Sunday's 113-105 loss to the Clippers.
5060701.s: With Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined, Anderson has logged 16-plus minutes in four consecutive contests. The rookie guard made the most of his increased playing time Sunday, as he chipped in a career-high scoring total while providing a spark off the bench, albeit in a losing effort. He should continue seeing increased burn for as long as Schroder is unavailable.

5060701.h: Charlotte recalled Anderson from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday.
5060701.s: With Dennis Schroder (thigh) questionable for Friday against Boston, the Hornets could be very shorthanded, considering Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is out once again. Anderson is projected to provide emergency depth in the short term.

5060701.h: The Hornets assigned Anderson to the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday.
5060701.s: Anderson will have an opportunity to receive additional playing time and develop his game with Greensboro. The assignment suggests the rookie guard isn't currently part of Charlotte's regular rotation, leaving him without meaningful fantasy value in standard leagues.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5060701.s: The rookie first-rounder was dealing with an ankle injury during the preseason, and he may have slightly aggravated the issue during the Hornets' 128-81 loss to the Hawks on Friday, when he played 16 minutes and finished with two points, two assists and one block. The injury doesn't appear to be a long-term concern for Anderson, and he's expected to be available for Saturday's contest.

5060701.h: Anderson tallied 15 points (3-7 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 8-9 FT), two rebounds, six assists and one steal across 22 minutes in Friday's 117-98 preseason loss to the Grizzlies.
5060701.s: Anderson led Charlotte in assists and got to the line nine times, scoring in double figures for the second time in as many preseason appearances. Conversely, he committed four turnovers on a night when the Hornets coughed it up 24 times. The No. 18 overall pick in the 2026 draft could find backup point guard minutes early in the season if Coby White (calf) remains sidelined.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) recorded 10 points (4-8 FG, 2-3 3Pt), one rebound, one assist and two steals across 21 minutes in Wednesday's 114-93 preseason loss to Boston.
5060701.s: After missing Charlotte's first two preseason contests with an ankle sprain, Anderson made an efficient return, shooting 50 percent from the field while connecting on two of three attempts from deep. The rookie guard also contributed defensively with two steals, giving the Hornets a promising look at his potential as he competes for backcourt minutes.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against the Celtics.
5060701.s: Anderson has recovered from a left ankle injury. The rookie first-rounder is making his preseason debut as he battles for an Opening Night role.

5061568.h: Bryant provided eight points (3-8 FG, 2-7 3Pt) and three rebounds in 20 minutes during Saturday's 114-91 win over New Orleans.
5061568.s: Bryant saw 20 minutes of action for the first time this season in this blowout victory. However, the second-year forward didn't deliver his most efficient effort. He's logged double-digit minutes in three of his last five appearances, averaging 3.8 points and 1.6 rebounds in 11.8 minutes per tilt over that stretch.

5061568.h: Bryant recorded zero points (0-1 FG, 0-1 3Pt) across two minutes during Tuesday's 105-93 loss to Detroit.
5061568.s: Bryant has gone scoreless in consecutive appearances, playing just seven combined minutes after averaging 9.0 points across his previous two outings. The second-year forward has seen his playing time decline sharply from 19 to five to two minutes over his last three games. His inconsistent role in San Antonio's rotation leaves him with minimal fantasy value outside deeper dynasty leagues.

5061568.h: Bryant provided eight points (2-4 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), one rebound and one assist over 14 minutes during Monday's 122-96 win over Phoenix.
5061568.s: Bryant played 14 minutes off the bench, maintaining a limited role despite the blowout victory. It's been an underwhelming campaign thus far for Bryant, who has exceeded 15 minutes only twice in 10 appearances. He has barely been a top-400 player to this point, averaging 3.1 points in 10.3 minutes per game.

5061568.h: Bryant totaled four points (2-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt) and one rebound over 10 minutes during Saturday's 122-106 win over the Mavericks.
5061568.s: Bryant logged double-digit minutes for the first time this season, scoring his first points of the 2026-27 campaign. The second-year forward faces an uphill climb for a steady role, especially once Tobias Harris (calf) returns.

5061568.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Bryant for the 2027-28 season, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
5061568.s: Bryant, the 2025 No. 14 overall pick, appeared in 71 regular-season games as a rookie in 2025-26. He got off to a slow start but demonstrated signs of growth by ending the year averaging 7.0 points and 1.9 assists in seven regular-season appearances in April. Bryant should be more productive in 2026-27, though the verdict is still out regarding just how high his ceiling can be at the professional level. The Spurs…

5061568.h: Bryant tallied 16 points (4-7 FG, 4-7 3Pt, 4-4 FT), five rebounds and two blocks over 20 minutes during Wednesday's 123-103 preseason win over the Suns.
5061568.s: Bryant appeared to have the green light to fire away from deep, connecting on a team-high four triples. The second-year forward is an option for a larger role off the bench while Tobias Harris (calf) is on the shelf.

5061568.h: Carter (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
5061568.s: Bryant didn't play in Monday's preseason meeting with the Jazz. However, he is cleared to return Wednesday versus the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.
5061568.s: Bryant exited Saturday's preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, so the Spurs are giving him a day to recover Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant exited Saturday's 102-98 preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5061568.s: Bryant suffered the injury after stepping on teammate Devin Vassell's foot and was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the contest. However, McDonald suggested the decision was precautionary rather than indicative of a serious injury, while coach Mitch Johnson also characterized the early exit as precautionary. The second-year forward's status for Monday's preseason matchup against Utah remains uncertain,…

5061568.h: Bryant finished with 11 points (3-8 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 3-4 FT), five rebounds, one steal and one block in 23 minutes during Thursday's 123-116 preseason loss to Atlanta.
5061568.s: Bryant showed encouraging offensive development, knocking down two three-pointers while contributing on the glass and defensively. The second-year forward committed four turnovers but appeared more comfortable making decisions with the ball compared to his rookie campaign. Bryant will look to build on the performance as he competes for a larger role in San Antonio's forward rotation.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
5061575.s: Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
5061575.s: Knueppel aggravated his left hamstring strain in his season debut Wednesday against Brooklyn. The Hornets haven't yet indicated whether the sharpshooter is facing a multi-week absence, but they'll likely proceed with caution. Grayson Allen is back in the mix as a high-end fantasy streaming option for as long as Knueppel is out.

5061575.h: Knueppel exited Wednesday's game against the Nets after experiencing soreness in his left leg, and he will not return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5061575.s: This is the same leg that delayed Knueppel's season debut, but for now the team is calling it a leg injury rather than specifically citing his hamstring. Still, it's concerning that he seemingly suffered a non-contact injury after just six minutes of play. For now, Knueppel should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Celtics.

5061575.h: Knueppel (leg) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Nets, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5061575.s: Knueppel was cleared to make his season debut Wednesday after dealing with a left hamstring strain. However, he limped back to the locker room midway through the opening quarter and can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
5061575.s: Knueppel hasn't played this season, though it appears he will make his 2026-27 campaign debut versus Brooklyn. It may take him a few games to ramp up. However, Knueppel's return, even in a limited capacity, will presumably send Sion James back to the bench.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game versus the Pistons.
5061575.s: While he is moving in the right direction, Knueppel will remain out for Monday's meeting with Detroit. For now, he should be considered week-to-week. Coby White (calf) is off the injury report, so his return will help lessen the blow, even if he plays limited minutes.

5061575.h: The Hornets exercised Knueppel's (hamstring) third-year team option on Sunday.
5061575.s: Knueppel has yet to play in 2026-27 while dealing with a left hamstring injury, but it's clear he's one of Charlotte's foundational pieces going forward. Across 81 regualr-season games (80 starts) as a rookie, Knueppel averaged 18.5 points, 5.3 rebounds, 3.4 assists and 3.4 three-pointers in 31.5 minutes per contest helping him finish second in Rookie of the Year voting.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.
5061575.s: Knueppel was able to log a practice with the Swarm on Thursday. While there's been no official update on his progress, it's safe to assume he's at least trending in the right direction. A timetable for his return has yet to be announced.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) will practice with the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday, the Hornets announced.
5061575.s: Although the second-year sharpshooter hasn't been given an official timetable, this suggests that he's progressing toward a return. Knueppel will almost certainly be recalled shortly after practice, though an update on his progress may not be given immediately.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
5061575.s: Knueppel has yet to take the floor this season while on the mend from a left hamstring strain, and at this point in time, the team isn't ready to commit to a return date. Coach Charles Lee stated before Monday's game against Washington that he could have more clarity on the plan for Knueppel following the two-game road trip, which wraps up Friday in Washington.

5061585.h: Isaiah Evans SG MIN - Playing - Saturday vs MEM
Evans (illness) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Grizzlies.
5061585.s: Evans has seen sparse playing time at the NBA level this season, with most of his on-court minutes coming in the G League. He's been a healthy scratch for each of the Timberwolves' last two games, but he may not be available at all depending on his recovery from an illness leading up to Saturday's 8:00 p.m. ET tipoff.

5061585.h: Minnesota recalled Evans from the G League's Iowa Wolves on Thursday.

5061585.h: Evans finished with 21 points (6-13 FG, 5-10 3Pt, 4-4 FT), two rebounds and three assists over 30 minutes in Friday's 133-116 preseason loss to Chicago.
5061585.s: Evans had a fantastic showing, scoring more points Friday than he had in his previous four preseason games combined. 5061585.h: Evans registered nine points (3-7 FG, 3-5 3Pt), three rebounds, one assist and one block in 22 minutes during Saturday's 125-124 preseason win over the Heat.
5061585.s: The Timberwolves rested their projected starting unit and Ayo Dosunmu, leading to increased playing time for Evans. The rookie guard tied for second on the team in three-pointers made and was one of just three Minnesota players to knock down multiple triples. Evans will compete with Bones Hyland and Jaylen Clark for playing time off the bench to begin the regular season.

His limited offensive involvement and struggles at the free-throw line remain concerns for category-based fantasy formats, but his rebounding and defensive upside make him useful when he receives a substantial frontcourt workload. Assuming his playing time increases over the next few games, Missi is someone who should be rostered in all…

5061589.h: Missi (knee) has been upgraded to probable for Saturday's game versus the Nuggets.
5061589.s: A bone bruise in Missi's left knee has kept him on the sidelines since Oct. 23, though he appears likely to end his 11-game stretch of absences Saturday.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
5061589.s: Even though Missi has been trending in the right direction and was recently cleared to resume on-court activities, this game will come too soon for him. This means Missi will miss an 11th consecutive game while dealing with a left knee bone bruise. His next chance to play will come Saturday against the Nuggets, and in the meantime, Karlo Matkovic figures to remain in the starting lineup.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
5061589.s: Missi has been sidelined since picking up a left knee bone bruise Oct. 23. He remains without a timetable to return and can be considered week-to-week moving forward.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

5105637.s: Bona hasn't played since Nov. 4 due to a back sprain, though he appears to be trending in the right direction. Until the big man is cleared to play, Dominick Barlow (back) and Jabari Walker are candidates for increased minutes.

5105806.s: Howard wasn't included on Dallas' initial injury report, though he's now in jeopardy of sitting out the team's regular-season opener due to right calf tightness. However, the two-way player's potential absence wouldn't cause any waves in the rotation.

5105806.s: Howard will miss another preseason contest due to an illness. However, he should be ready to go for Opening Night against the Rockets, barring a setback.
