5105809.h: Reed amassed seven points (1-1 FG, 5-6 FT), seven rebounds, one assist and two blocks across 15 minutes during Monday's 123-107 win over the Kings.
5105809.s: Given a season-high workload, Reed helped the shorthanded Spurs earn a road win Monday. The rookie big man has had a hard time carving out steady minutes when the frontcourt is healthy, and it's likely Reed descends into a lesser role once Victor Wembanyama (back) returns to the court.

5105809.h: Reed provided two points (1-2 FG) and three rebounds in seven minutes during Saturday's 122-106 win over the Mavericks.
5105809.s: Reed saw a bump in playing time after not seeing the floor in Friday's loss to Houston. The rookie center is currently off the fantasy radar, as he's behind Victor Wembanyama and Luke Kornet on the depth chart.

5105809.h: Reed logged four points (2-2 FG), nine rebounds, one assist, three blocks and one steal over 21 minutes during Wednesday's 123-103 preseason win over Phoenix.
5105809.s: Reed was one board shy from reaching double-digits in that category for a second consecutive game, and he showed off his defensive prowess with four combined blocks and steals. Luke Kornet (rest) was the Spurs' main rotational big man behind Victor Wembanyama last season, but Reed should have some opportunities to contribute off the bench during his rookie campaign.

5105809.h: Reed supplied four points (1-6 FG, 2-4 FT), 17 rebounds, four steals, one assist and one block over 24 minutes in Monday's 119-109 preseason loss to Utah.
5105809.s: Reed's scoring numbers were pedestrian, but his impact on the glass was massive, as he hauled in a game-high 17 rebounds, including eight on the offensive end. The 23-year-old's four steals were also a team high. Victor Wembanyama is the unquestioned starter at center, but Reed could compete with veteran Luke Kornet for playing time off the bench while fellow rookie Jayden Quaintance (knee) remains without a…

5105809.h: Reed recorded two points (0-2 FG, 2-2 FT), six rebounds and one assist in 17 minutes during Thursday's 123-116 preseason loss to Atlanta.
5105809.s: Reed struggled to generate offense but made his presence felt on the glass, collecting two offensive rebounds while avoiding turnovers. The rookie center received an extended opportunity in the second half, although his path to regular-season minutes remains difficult with Victor Wembanyama and Luke Kornet ahead of him in San Antonio's frontcourt rotation.

5105809.h: Reed could have a hard time cracking San Antonio's Opening Night rotation.
5105809.s: Reed lines up as the Spurs' third-string center behind Victor Wembanyama and Luke Kornet in 2026-27. Jayden Quaintance's status for the start of his rookie season appears to be in serious doubt due to offseason knee surgery, but Reed is still likely to need an injury to either Wembanyama or Kornet in order to come into legitimate fantasy relevance.

5105837.h: The Rockets recalled Thornton from the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers on Sunday, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
5105837.s: The Vipers don't play again until Saturday's contest versus the Memphis Hustle, so Thornton will return to the parent club for the time being. However, it wouldn't be surprising to see the rookie second-rounder continue getting reps with the G League squad.

5105837.s: Thornton's assignment indicates he'll continue his development in the G League rather than compete for regular minutes in Houston's rotation. 5105837.h: Houston recalled Thornton from the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers on Saturday.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh recorded 18 points (6-13 FG, 5-7 3Pt, 1-2 FT), three rebounds and one assist in 26 minutes during Friday's 111-101 loss to the Suns.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh bounced back from a quiet night against the Lakers and gave Utah another scoring punch off the bench, finishing tied for second on the team in points. 5105839.h: Sensabaugh provided 40 points (16-21 FG, 8-11 3Pt, 0-1 FT), 11 rebounds, five assists and one block over 35 minutes during Tuesday's 132-107 victory over the Clippers.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh exploded off the bench for a season high, more than doubling his previous best of the campaign and torching the Clippers from beyond the arc. His minutes were sporadic early in the season, but his role has grown over the past week with Lauri Markkanen (hand) out.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh provided 14 points (7-13 FG, 0-4 3Pt), seven rebounds, two assists and one block across 30 minutes during Sunday's 110-102 loss to the Spurs.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh logged a season-high 30 minutes and provided a spark off the bench, leading the second unit in scoring. The 23-year-old has played at least 23 minutes in three straight games, averaging 13.3 points, 4.3 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 0.7 blocks in 26.7 minutes per tilt over that span. He'll likely see increased burn for as long as Jaren Jackson (knee) and Lauri Markkanen (hand) are sidelined.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh produced 19 points (6-10 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 4-5 FT), three rebounds, one assist, one block and one steal across 23 minutes off the bench during Wednesday's 123-108 loss to Orlando.
5105839.s: The fourth-year wing finished second on the Jazz in scoring behind Darryn Peterson's 22 points, and Sensabaugh's 19 points were a season high. The performance ended a streak of five straight games in which he'd scored in single digits, and he's struggling to earn the same kind of court time he did during a breakout 2025-26. Sensabaugh's 23 minutes Wednesday were also a season high, but still less than the 23.5…

5105839.h: Sensabaugh recorded 16 points (5-9 FG, 4-5 3Pt, 2-2 FT), three rebounds and one assist in 18 minutes during Wednesday's 117-111 overtime loss to San Antonio.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh helped pick up the slack left behind by Lauri Markkanen (wrist) and Jaren Jackson (knee) on Wednesday. Sensabaugh should continue playing the backup role at shooting guard, provided rookie first-rounder Darryn Peterson hangs onto a starting job.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh closed with seven points (3-7 FG, 1-4 3Pt), six rebounds and one assist across 17 minutes during Sunday's 132-123 loss to the Lakers.
5105839.s: The 22-year-old grabbed a season-high six rebounds during Utah's second loss of the 2026-27 campaign. Sensabaugh will continue operating in a reserve role behind Ace Bailey and Lauri Markkanen in the frontcourt.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh closed with 11 points (3-7 FG, 2-5 3Pt, 3-4 FT), one steal, two rebounds and two assists across 15 minutes in Monday's 119-109 preseason win over the Spurs.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh was solid off the bench Monday. He's ticketed for a reserve role to begin this year after spending some time as a starter for an injury-plagued Jazz team late last season.

Smith drew his first career start and provided a full stat line, leading the Pacers in assists while finishing as their third-leading scorer. The two-way player's minutes should dip significantly moving forward, though he's making a case to remain in the rotation while Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) and T.J. McConnell…

5105854.h: Smith will start Monday's game against the Hawks, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
5105854.s: The Pacers will be extremely shorthanded in the second half of this back-to-back set, opening the door for Smith to make his first career start. The two-way player has logged double-digit minutes just once this season, but the Pacers will need him to take on a heavy workload Monday.

5105854.h: Smith finished with five points (2-9 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 1-2 FT), five assists and two rebounds over 16 minutes in Tuesday's 114-112 preseason loss to Oklahoma City.
5105854.s: Smith appears to be a long shot to start the season with the Pacers. The expectation, however, is that the two-way player will be an integral component of the G League's Noblesville Boom.

5106058.h: Sharp recorded nine points (3-6 FG, 3-6 3Pt), two rebounds, three assists and one steal in 25 minutes before fouling out of Wednesday's 129-110 loss to the Warriors.

5106058.h: Sharp totaled three points (1-6 FG, 1-5 3Pt) and one steal across 16 minutes during Saturday's 97-96 victory over the Celtics.
5106058.s: Sharp saw a bump in minutes after logging just nine in his previous appearance. However, his shooting woes continued Saturday, and he's shot just 25.9 percent from the field over the last four games. During that span, the rookie second-rounder has averaged 5.3 points and 1.3 steals in 15.0 minutes per contest.

5106058.h: Sharp contributed nine points (3-3 FG, 3-3 3Pt), three rebounds, one assist, one block and one steal over 20 minutes during Monday's 115-100 win over Dallas.
5106058.s: Sharp made all three of his attempts from beyond the arc, providing efficient bench scoring in Sacramento's first win of the campaign. He also chipped in defensively, but his limited shot volume and uncertain night-to-night workload make him difficult to trust outside deeper fantasy leagues.

5106058.h: Sharp racked up three points (1-3 FG, 1-2 3Pt), one rebound and one block across 14 minutes during Sunday's 123-112 loss to the Grizzlies.
5106058.s: The rookie second-rounder has somewhat surprisingly nailed down a rotation spot in the early going with the rebuilding Kings. That's perhaps due to Ben Simmons going down for the season with an Achilles injury, but Sharp isn't quite yet on fantasy radars in most leagues.

5106058.h: Sharp recorded 11 points (3-9 FG, 3-9 3Pt, 2-5 FT), three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 21 minutes during Thursday's 114-110 preseason loss to the Lakers.
5106058.s: Sharp provided Sacramento with perimeter scoring off the bench, accounting for all three of his field goals from beyond the arc. Although he struggled at the free-throw line, the rookie guard demonstrated his willingness to shoot from distance and avoided committing a turnover. Sharp will look to build on the performance as he competes for a spot in Sacramento's regular-season backcourt rotation.

5106058.h: Sharp faces increased competition for playing time after the Kings signed Ben Simmons to a one-year deal Friday.
5106058.s: Although Russell Westbrook is out of the picture now, Ben Simmons will return to The Association and figures to see a steady role in the Kings' rotation thanks to his defensive versatility and playmaking. Along with fellow rookie Alex Karaban, Sharp isn't guaranteed a meaningful role to begin his professional career. However, the No. 45 overall pick out of Houston could see increasingly steady minutes as the season…

5106060.h: Walker finished with eight points (2-2 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 3-4 FT), one rebound and three assists across 11 minutes during Friday's 128-119 loss to the Cavaliers.

5106060.h: Walker recorded 15 points (6-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds, three assists, one block and one steal in 45 minutes during Monday's 108-104 loss to the Hawks.
5106060.s: Walker played a team-high 45 minutes as Indiana dressed only six players, providing steady contributions across multiple categories despite struggling from beyond the arc. 5106060.s: The Pacers have just eight players dressing for Monday's home tilt with the Hawks, pushing Walker into the starting lineup. With that in mind, he should see a massive boost in minutes and usage.

5106060.h: Walker will start Friday's game against the Mavericks, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

5106060.h: Walker (rest) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Pelicans.

5106258.h: Dick notched 15 points (6-7 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 1-2 FT), four rebounds and two steals in 17 minutes during Sunday's 139-123 victory over the Pelicans.

5106258.s: Dick started in Monday's 125-118 loss to Toronto, finishing with 12 points, four rebounds, three assists and two steals. However, with Rui Hachimura (quadriceps) back in the lineup, Dick will return to the bench.

5106258.s: With the rebuilding Clippers dealing with several injuries already, Dick stitched up an Opening Night rotation spot. A 2023 first-rounder, Dick remains worth monitoring on waiver wires until his role becomes more solidified.
